deals.title: $15 off first catering order of $150+ (SAVE15PR)
deals.details: $15 off first-time catering orders with a subtotal of $150 or more before taxes and fees. Order online at churchs.com/catering (the release also mentions catering.churchs.com) and enter SAVE15PR at checkout. You must register a catering account. Limit one offer per guest. Can't be combined with any other offer. Orders can be placed up to 90 days ahead, with pickup or delivery at participating locations. Pricing, participation and menu items vary by location, and the offer can be cancelled or changed at any time without notice.
deals.sourceName: Church's Texas Chicken press release (PRNewswire via Franchising.com)
deals.notes: Catering orders only, not regular orders, and only at participating locations, so check that your San Antonio store offers catering. Runs 6/29/26 to 12/31/26.

deals.title: Never-Ending Pasta Bowl from $14.99
deals.details: Starts at $14.99. Endless pasta from 120 pasta, homemade sauce and protein-topping combinations, with never-ending soup or salad and breadsticks. Refills, soup/salad and breadsticks are dine-in only. Toppings cost extra: you pay the topping charge once and can switch toppings on refills. New this year are Spicy Alfredo sauce and Crispy Shrimp Fritta (limited time). Gluten-free rotini is available on request. Prices and availability may vary by location.
deals.sourceName: Olive Garden press release via PR Newswire (July 13, 2026)
deals.notes: The $100 Never-Ending Pasta Pass is a separate offer and isn't part of this deal. Olive Garden lists no end date, only "limited time only."

deals.title: Game Day Boost: 50 bonus pts on Saturday online orders
deals.details: Schlotzsky's Rewards members earn 50 bonus points on Saturday online orders at participating locations. Single use; apply the reward at checkout. Not combinable with other offers or rewards, or third-party delivery. Points may take up to 24 hours to post. Service fees and taxes may apply.
deals.notes: The page is unclear: the headline says online orders, but the fine print says in-store or online. "Single use" may mean once per member, not each Saturday. Participating stores aren't listed.

deals.title: 50% off a Dave's Single w/ purchase (code FOXBigNoon)
deals.details: Half off a Dave's Single with any purchase. Log into your Wendy's Rewards account in the Wendy's app, enter code FOXBigNoon under 'Redeem Promo Code', and redeem in the app. You only need to enter the code once. Per Living On The Cheap, it refreshes weekly on Saturday and can be used once per week. Boo! Books don't count as the qualifying purchase. Participating U.S. Wendy's, limited time. Tie-in with FOX Big Noon Kickoff.
deals.notes: Redeem in the Wendy's app with the code; an app account is required. Resets Saturdays, once per week, at participating locations. The Dec 4 end date comes from a deal site, not Wendy's.

deals.title: New customers: $10 off first $20+ order
deals.details: Newly registered Uber Eats customers only. $10 off a first order of $20 or more. DealNews says the code is capped at 9,000 total uses and that some exclusions apply. Enter it in the app's Promotions section before checkout. Existing accounts are not eligible.
deals.notes: Uber doesn't publish this code. A deal site reports it, and it looks like an affiliate code. It reportedly expires Oct 31 and can run out early (9,000 uses). Not tested at checkout.

deals.title: Monopoly at McDonald's: scan pieces to win food & prizes
deals.details: Peel physical game pieces from eligible items and scan them in the McDonald's app. You need a MyMcDonald's Rewards account and must register for the game. Breakfast items with pieces: hash browns, McMuffins, biscuit sandwiches. All day: large cold drinks (soft drink, iced coffee, iced tea, McCafe) and large hot McCafe drinks. Rest of day: large fries, 10-pc McNuggets, Quarter Pounder with Cheese, Big Mac, 4-pc McCrispy Strips. Ordering in the app or with your Rewards code gives a bonus Chance Card play. Prizes include free food (e.g., McChicken, Snack Wrap, small fries), 1,500 to 7,000 Rewards points, and collect-to-win and Chance Card prizes up to $1M. Purchase entries end Nov 1, 11:59 p.m. local time. Chance Card play continues through Nov 8. Prize claim deadline: Nov 22, 2026. No purchase needed: mail a self-addressed stamped envelope inside a stamped outer envelope to Monopoly Game at McDonald's Game Piece Request, PO Box 4006, Dept. S9851, Grand Rapids, MN 55730-4006. It must be received by Nov 2, 2026. One piece per outer envelope. Participating restaurants only.
deals.notes: Chance Card plays run through Nov 8, 2026, and prizes must be claimed by Nov 22. No separate deadline is listed for scanning pieces.

deals.title: Free ExtraMostBestest pizza w/ $20+ Grubhub order
deals.details: Grubhub National Pizza Month, second window (Oct 19-31). Free ExtraMostBestest round pizza when your Little Caesars order on Grubhub is $20 or more. No promo code is listed by any source. The free pizza is presumably added from the Little Caesars menu in the Grubhub app, but no source says so; check the store's Grubhub page. Participating San Antonio Little Caesars locations on Grubhub only.
deals.sourceName: MassLive via Yahoo (also EatDrinkDeals, The Freebie Guy)
deals.notes: Needs a $20+ Grubhub order. Sources don't say whether Grubhub+ is required, so check the Grubhub app before ordering.

deals.title: Free medium pepperoni pizza w/ $20+ Grubhub order
deals.details: Grubhub National Pizza Month, second window (Oct 19-31). Free medium pepperoni pizza on Papa John's orders of $20 or more placed on Grubhub. No promo code is listed. Participating San Antonio Papa John's locations on Grubhub only.
deals.sourceName: MassLive via Yahoo (also Danny the Deal Guru, The Freebie Guy)
deals.notes: Needs a $20+ Grubhub order. Sources don't say whether Grubhub+ is required or whether existing customers qualify, so check the Grubhub app first.

deals.title: Free Single ShackBurger w/ $10+ order (code SCARYGOOD)
deals.details: Enter code SCARYGOOD (case-sensitive, all caps) at checkout in the Shake Shack app, on ShakeShack.com, or at an in-Shack kiosk. Requires $10+ of other food/drink; the free sandwich, gift cards, taxes, and delivery/other fees don't count toward the $10. Limit one free promotional sandwich per order. Paid add-ons (bacon, avocado) cost extra. Can't be combined with other offers. While supplies last. Not valid for drive-thru orders, third-party delivery apps, or Shacks in airports, stadiums, arenas, travel plazas, or museums. Participating U.S. Shacks only.
deals.notes: The promo item may change daily, so confirm the app shows the ShackBurger before ordering. Works on kiosk, app and web; drive-thru excluded. San Antonio Shacks: 7427 San Pedro Ave and 3003 Broadway.

deals.title: $4 Paris Hilton's Usual bundle (through Mon 10/26)
deals.details: $4 plus tax for a Diablo Ranch Crispy Chicken Crunchwrap Slider, a Crunchy Taco and a medium fountain drink. Drinks exclude Freezes and specialty beverages. Limit 1 offer per transaction. Participating U.S. locations only; prices, hours and participation vary; prices may be higher with delivery. Doja Cat's Usual replaces it on Tue 10/27.
deals.notes: Ends Monday 10/26. Taco Bell doesn't say what time Tuesday the next bundle takes over.

deals.title: Amex Offer: $6 back on $20+ Grubhub order (2x)
deals.details: Add the offer to your card in the Amex app or website first. Then make a single purchase of $20 or more on Grubhub or Seamless (website or app) to get a $6 statement credit, up to 2 times ($12 total) per card member. U.S. sites and apps only, in U.S. dollars. Gift cards and corporate cards are excluded; payments through third-party processors or digital wallets may not qualify. The charge must post by 2026-12-31.
deals.notes: Targeted: check your account. Amex Offers vary by account and may not show on your card. Reported at $6 through 12/31/26, but older versions were $5, so check the amount on your own offer. The add-by date is unknown.

deals.title: 20% off $25+ delivery, up to $8 off (BRBCRYING)

Subject to delivery availability; no cash value; non-transferable.
deals.notes: Plan on a $25 minimum; DoorDash's post also mentions $15. Select items only. It's unclear if the code is for new customers or needs DashPass, so it may not work on every account. Chick-fil-A is excluded.

deals.title: $1.25 candy bars for 7Rewards members
deals.details: Loyalty (7Rewards / Speedy Rewards) members pay $1.25 each, plus tax, at participating stores for: Reese's Original, Kit Kat Original, Hershey Milk Chocolate, Hershey Almond and Almond Joy (standard size); Nerds Rainbow and Halloween Ropes; Gushers Tropical and Super Sour Berry; Snickers Original, Twix Original and Starburst Original (standard size).

deals.title: $3 Original Glazed dozen w/ any dozen purchase

San Antonio shops: 2703 SE Military Dr; 8815 Potranco Rd; 1117 N Loop 1604 E; 12328 I-10 West.
deals.notes: Only Oct 24-25 remain. Krispy Kreme's page lists no limits or exclusions. Code SCARYGOOD comes from deal sites and may not be needed in shop or at the drive-thru.

deals.title: Birthday perk for 7 Brew Rewards members

deals.notes: No end date published (reported Oct 18 as this week's deal); may have ended. Check the 7-Eleven app.

deals.notes: No end date announced. Price and participation vary by location, so check the Arby's app for your San Antonio store.

deals.title: Amex Offer: 10% back at Auntie Anne's (max $4)

deals.location: 22103 Bulverde Rd #106, San Antonio, TX 78259

deals.notes: App-exclusive offers. Limit one redemption per customer per offer.

deals.details: Baskin-Robbins Rewards members can mix and match any 3 small Mangonadas, small Smoothies, double scoops or Creature Creations for $15 plus tax. Only qualifying products count. Valid at participating U.S. shops. Not valid for delivery. Redeem through your Rewards account in the BR app.

deals.title: Kids eat free Tuesdays after 5 PM
deals.details: Tuesdays after 5 PM: kids eat free. The restaurant's site gives no age limit, no purchase requirement (such as one adult meal) and no dine-in rule, so ask when you order. Phone (210) 734-2627.
deals.location: 447 W Hildebrand Ave, San Antonio, TX 78212

deals.details: Sign in to Capital One Offers, pick the Blue Apron offer, and follow its link. Complete the order in that same browser session within 24 hours, using a personal Capital One card. Listed as up to 10% cash back or 10x miles. The rate can change. Taxes, shipping and fees are excluded. Can't be stacked with Rakuten. Rewards usually post in about 45 days (within 3 billing cycles).

deals.sourceName: The Krazy Coupon Lady (updated Oct 1, 2026); Hip2Save (Feb 25, 2026)

deals.notes: Sources conflict on free vs. 50% off and on dine-in eligibility; BWW's FAQ also mentions needing a Rewards account. Limit 1, third-party delivery excluded, participating locations. Check the BWW app before going. Thursday boneless BOGO is a separate entry.

deals.title: Kids eat free Mon & Fri w/ $10+ (New Braunfels)

deals.notes: The brand doesn't say whether a purchase is required, whether it's dine-in only, or how long the offer lasts. Check with your restaurant.

deals.title: Free birthday treat for Chick-fil-A One members
deals.details: Chick-fil-A One members (free to join): on your birthday, check the Rewards tab of the Chick-fil-A App for 'something sweet, on us.' Your birthday needs to be in your app profile. Deal sites report it as a Chocolate Chunk Cookie or Chocolate Fudge Brownie. Participating locations.
deals.notes: The brand says only 'something sweet'; deal sites report a cookie or brownie. Check the app for the actual reward and how long you have to redeem it.

deals.title: Free Chick Meal during birthday month
deals.details: Chicken Salad Chick Rewards members get a free Chick Meal during their birthday month. Save your birthday in the app. The brand's general reward terms: limit one per person, per mobile device, per visit/day; can't be combined with other offers or discounts; no cash value.
deals.notes: The brand doesn't give timing. One deal site says the reward appears on the 1st of your birthday month and lasts 30 days. Stores in San Antonio, New Braunfels and Boerne.

deals.title: Free birthday dessert (My Chili's Rewards)
deals.details: My Chili's Rewards members get a free dessert on their birthday. It expires 10 days after it's issued. Redeem through the Chili's app or tabletop device in the restaurant, or at checkout on chilis.com. Participating US Chili's.
deals.notes: The dessert isn't specified. Benefits generally need a $5 food or beverage purchase, so expect that here (not confirmed). The 10-day window likely starts when the reward is issued, which may not be your birthday.

deals.title: Free chips & salsa every visit for My Chili's members
deals.details: My Chili's members get free chips & salsa on joining and every visit, with a minimum $5 food/beverage purchase (before tax, tip and donations). Benefits arrive by email, text, the Chili's app or the tabletop device; follow the claim instructions. A benefit can't be redeemed in the same transaction it was earned. Members also get a free birthday dessert that expires 10 days after it's issued. Participating locations; non-transferable, no cash value.
deals.location: San Antonio-area Chili's (15 locations, incl. The Quarry 255 E Basse, Stone Oak 22402 US-281 N, Dezavala 12503 IH-10 W, Converse, Selma, Schertz)
deals.sourceName: Chili's My Chili's Rewards page and terms
deals.notes: The terms don't say whether chips & salsa can be redeemed on to-go orders, so check before ordering takeout.

deals.title: Free birthday side or drink (Chipotle Rewards)
deals.details: Chipotle Rewards members pick one free birthday reward during their birthday month: chips, guac, queso, or a drink. You need a Chipotle Rewards account with your birthday on file (it's collected at registration). Redeem in the app or online.
deals.notes: The brand says 'birthday month'; one deal site says to redeem within 30 days of your birthday. Rewards generally expire 60 days after being added, so check the expiration in the app.

deals.title: New Rewards members: free chips & guac w/ $5+
deals.details: Join Chipotle Rewards to get a sign-up offer of free Chips & Guacamole, with a $5 minimum purchase. Chipotle's FAQ says new members 'may' receive a sign-up offer, so it isn't guaranteed for everyone. EatDrinkDeals reports the offer expires 7 days after you sign up. Redeem in the app, online, or in-restaurant through your Rewards account.
deals.notes: Only one deal site reports a 7-day expiry. Chipotle's own terms don't state one; rewards default to 60 days and bonus rewards may expire sooner. Check the expiration in the app.

deals.title: Buy 60+ Play Points, get 30 free (BOO2026)
deals.details: Halloween Boo-tacular coupon. Open Chuck E. Cheese's coupon request form with code BOO2026 and fill in every required field: email, first name, last name, age and ZIP code. This adds you to the mailing list, and the newsletter checkbox is optional. A link to a digital coupon is emailed right away. The coupon gives 30 free Play Points when you buy 60 or more Play Points, up to a $25 value per Haunted Attraction Network. It's free, with one coupon per household. Show it on your phone or print it at the counter of a participating Fun Center. Chuck E. Cheese's coupon FAQ says most coupons are one per transaction and can't be combined with Fun Pass discounts, and terms can vary by location.
deals.sourceName: Chuck E. Cheese coupon request page (also Hip2Save Halloween Restaurant Deals, Oct 22, 2026; Haunted Attraction Network, Oct 1, 2026)
deals.notes: This requests an emailed coupon; you don't type it at checkout. The Nov 1 end date comes from one outside source, so check the date on your coupon. Participating locations only.

deals.title: Topping Tuesday: BOGO 50% off large pizza
deals.details: Tuesdays: buy one large pizza, get a second at 50% off. Participating locations only. Weekly deals can't be combined with other offers. Most coupons also can't be combined with Fun Pass discounts.
deals.sourceName: Chuck E. Cheese coupons & deals page
deals.notes: The brand doesn't say if it's dine-in, carryout or online, or which San Antonio stores take part; check locally. A separate online code, BOGOLarge, is reported through Oct 31.

deals.title: Chick or Treat: weekly mystery reward in app
deals.details: Real Rewards members can log in to the Church's app each week, tap a Halloween-themed door and reveal a mystery reward. Runs through the end of October.
deals.notes: Needs a Real Rewards account. Rewards are random and the article didn't list them. One trade-press source (Oct 21, 2026); Church's site wouldn't load to confirm.

deals.title: Free delivery fee in Chuy's app with code APPFREE
deals.details: Order delivery in the new Chuy's app and enter code APPFREE to waive the delivery fee. Service fee still applies. Delivery depends on your address being in a store's delivery area.
deals.location: San Antonio-area Chuy's (Hwy 281, I-10 and Hwy 151 in San Antonio; Selma; New Braunfels)
deals.notes: No end date, order minimum or per-customer limit is published. Whether the code is one-time use is not stated.

deals.title: Happy hour: $5 Chips 'N' Dips, weekdays 3-6pm
deals.details: Weekdays 3-6pm: $5 Chips 'N' Dips (Queso, Compuesto, Lil' Chuy Gooey or Boom-Boom Pow), plus specials on House 'Ritas, House Texas 'Tinis, beer and wine. 21+ for drinks.
deals.notes: Availability and hours vary by location, so check your store. Drink prices aren't listed, to-go drinks are only at participating locations, and it's unclear if the $5 dips apply to takeout.

deals.title: Free 16 oz iced cold brew on your birthday
deals.details: Cinnabon Rewards members get a free small (16 oz) iced cold brew for their birthday. No purchase required. Usually valid about 14 days. Free Cinnabon Rewards account (app or website) with your birthday on file. Participating locations only.
deals.notes: Only one deal site gives the 14-day window; Cinnabon doesn't describe the perk. Many of San Antonio's 14 locations are likely inside other businesses, so check which accept Cinnabon Rewards.

deals.title: Sweet Savings Tuesday: CinnaPack deals in store
deals.details: Discounted CinnaPacks every Tuesday, in store only. The discount varies by location (at least 20% off), and Cinnabon Rewards members may get extra benefits.
deals.notes: Participating locations only; discount amount varies. The '$7 off online/app' version seen in roundups isn't backed by Cinnabon. Cinnabon can end it at any time.

deals.title: Free food & refreshments at Clarinet World opening
deals.details: Free public grand opening of a clarinet/music store, celebrating its move into a physical store after two years of selling online and at events across Texas. The listing mentions live performances, food & refreshments, giveaways and time to browse the store. Admission is free. The listing does not say what food is served, how much, or whether it lasts until supplies run out. It also gives no details about the giveaways.
deals.location: One De Zavala Center, 12758 Cimarron Path, Suite B126, San Antonio, TX 78249
deals.sourceName: Texas Public Radio community calendar (organizer-submitted listing)
deals.notes: Free food is a side part of a grand opening at a music retailer, not a restaurant. It's today (Sat, Oct 24); only one calendar listing reports it, and RSVP requirements are unknown.

deals.title: Birthday reward for My Cold Stone Club members
deals.details: Registered My Cold Stone Club members get a birthday reward loaded to their account 7 days before their birthday. It can be redeemed in store or online until 7 days after. Cold Stone's app listing describes it as Buy One, Get One Free.
deals.sourceName: Cold Stone Creamery – My Cold Stone Club Rewards
deals.notes: Account must be registered with your birthdate. Participating locations; one offer/reward per transaction.

deals.title: Free birthday cookie (Crumbl Rewards Silver tier+)
deals.details: Crumbl Rewards members at Silver status or higher get a free cookie voucher for their birthday. Silver means earning 500 Crumbs in the previous year, about $50 in purchases per Hip2Save. Hip2Save says to join and set your birthday at least 48 hours before your birthday. The voucher arrives in your Crumbl Rewards account; how long it stays valid isn't stated. Participating locations.
deals.sourceName: Hip2Save (Feb 25, 2026); The Krazy Coupon Lady (updated Oct 1, 2026)
deals.notes: Only one deal site reports the 48-hour lead time and the ~$50 figure; Crumbl's own page wasn't checked. How long the voucher stays valid is unknown.

deals.title: 25% off first order for new Culver's Rewards members
deals.details: Sign up for Culver's Delicious Rewards. A 25% Welcome offer appears in your account within an hour and is valid up to 2 weeks after issue. Use it on your first order after signing up. Account coupons can be scanned at the register in participating restaurants or used when ordering online.
deals.location: 5836 DeZavala Rd, San Antonio, TX 78249
deals.notes: Max discount, excluded items and delivery eligibility aren't stated. Only the DeZavala Rd store is listed within about 40 miles; it's open daily 10 AM-10:30 PM for dine-in and drive-thru.

deals.title: Free birthday & half-birthday custard dish
deals.details: Delicious Rewards members get a free single Create Your Own Dish of Fresh Frozen Custard with two toppings. It loads automatically on the 1st day of your birthday month and is valid for that whole month. A second one loads on the 1st day of your half-birthday month. Your birthday must be saved in your Delicious Rewards account. Redeem in the Culver's app or online, or scan your rewards in the restaurant.
deals.notes: Only one San Antonio-area store: 5836 DeZavala Rd. The birthday dish is valid all month; the half-birthday dish is presumably good for its own month, but that isn't stated. No purchase requirement is mentioned.

deals.title: Birthday offer in DQ app (DQ Rewards)
deals.details: If you're a DQ Rewards member and place an order of at least $1 while signed in during the 45 days before your birthday, a birthday offer appears in the Deals tab of the DQ app or on DQ.com on your birthday. It's valid for 7 days.
deals.notes: DQ doesn't say what the offer is. Deal sites mention a Blizzard, a BOGO Blizzard or a cone, so check the app. If you're new, sign up and order at least 1 day before your birthday.

deals.title: Free delivery Mondays on $15+ orders (DQ Rewards)
deals.details: DQ Rewards members get free delivery (up to $5.50) on Mondays when ordering in the DQ app or on DQ.com; reported minimum is $15.
deals.notes: Mondays only; Oct 26 is the last valid Monday (promo ends 11/1/26). Participating locations; extra fees may apply beyond 6 miles or due to driver availability.

deals.title: All-you-can-eat wings Mon & Thu (from $22.99)
deals.details: Every Monday and Thursday. All-you-can-eat traditional or boneless wings, priced from $22.99 per person (may vary by location and may increase). First order: 8 wings plus a side of ranch. Reorders: 6 wings. Buffalo, Honey BBQ or no sauce, one sauce per order; traditional and boneless can't be mixed. One per person, per seating. Dine-in only, no take-home bags. Not valid with any other promotion. Limited time.
deals.location: San Antonio-area D&B: 440 Crossroads Blvd (Balcones Heights); 849 E Commerce St (Rivercenter)
deals.notes: No end date or hours given; hours vary by location. The two San Antonio location pages don't mention the promo, so confirm the local price.

deals.title: Fall Watch Deals: $5 drinks, wings from $10 (Sun/Mon/Thu)
deals.details: Sundays, Mondays and Thursdays only. $5 drinks: 22 oz select domestic draft, Lime Time Margarita (rocks or frozen) and Transfusion; 21+ only. Wings: 10 traditional or boneless wings with one side of ranch or bleu cheese, one sauce or rub per order (no mixing sauces, or traditional and boneless), from $10 per person (may increase). Dine-in only, no take-home bags. Limited time; may be revised or rescinded at any time. Hours vary by location.
deals.location: San Antonio-area D&B: 440 Crossroads Blvd (Balcones Heights); 849 E Commerce St (Rivercenter)
deals.notes: No end date or hours given. San Antonio location pages list only a separate $5 drinks happy hour (Mon-Fri 4-7 PM, Sun-Thu 9-11 PM), not this promo, so confirm locally.

deals.title: App deals: $1 drink, $3 fries, $5 6-pc Bites
deals.details: In-app offers: small fountain drink for $1, fries for $3, or 6-piece Dave's Bites for $5. One offer per order. Offers may vary by account and location. Rewards points aren't earned or redeemed on third-party delivery orders.
deals.notes: No end date. Dave's own site doesn't show these offers. San Antonio participation wasn't confirmed, so check the app's store picker.

deals.title: 20% off next visit for joining Denny's Rewards
deals.details: New Denny's Rewards members reportedly get 20% off their next visit after signing up. Participating locations.
deals.notes: Only one source reports it, and Denny's site doesn't confirm it. Unknown: dine-in vs. online, how long it lasts after sign-up, and any minimum spend.

deals.title: Free Birthday Slam on your birthday (Denny's Rewards)
deals.details: Denny's Rewards members get a free Everyday Value Slam breakfast for their birthday, once a year. Valid on your birthday only (per Hip2Save). Free Denny's Rewards membership required; add your birthday to your account. Participating locations.
deals.notes: Unclear if it's dine-in only or also works for online orders. Only one deal site says birthday-only. Denny's lists 11 San Antonio restaurants.

deals.title: Mix & Match: any 2+ items $6.99 each
deals.details: Choose any 2 or more eligible items (including the NEW Domino) at $6.99 each; 2-item minimum. Bone-in wings, Handmade Pan and Parmesan Stuffed Crust cost extra. Stores may charge extra for some items, crusts, toppings and sauces. Delivery orders are subject to the store's delivery minimum and delivery charge (not a driver tip). You must choose or ask for the offer. Prices are higher at some locations; participation and delivery area vary by store.
deals.location: San Antonio-area Domino's
deals.notes: Limited time with no end date published. The full list of eligible items is not shown on the page.

deals.title: Weeklong carryout: $7.99 large 1-topping, wings & more
deals.details: Carryout only, any day: $7.99 each for a large 1-topping pizza (any of 6 crusts), 8-pc wings or boneless chicken, or the NEW Domino with 3 toppings. Excludes XL and specialty pizzas. Parmesan Stuffed Crust costs extra. Size availability varies by crust. Your store may charge extra for some toppings and sauces. You must ask for or choose the offer. Prices are higher at some locations; participation and charges may vary.
deals.location: San Antonio-area Domino's
deals.notes: Carryout only; delivery is excluded. You can still order online, in the app or by phone for pickup. Limited time, no end date published.

deals.title: Capital One Offer: up to $8 back at DoorDash
deals.details: Open Capital One Offers ("Credits for Shopping" in your card account or the app), pick the DoorDash offer, and click through to DoorDash. Finish the order with your Capital One card in that same browser session, within 24 hours of opening the offer. Listed as up to $8 cash back or 800 miles. Using other coupons, cash-back sites or promo sites after you pick the offer voids it. Personal Capital One cards only. The reward posts within about 3 billing cycles (often around 45 days).
deals.notes: Targeted: check your account. The amount changes often; only one source reports it (updated 10/1/26). There's no fixed end date, but offers can change daily.

deals.title: $6 Meal Deal: bacon egg & cheese, hash browns, coffee
deals.details: Bacon, egg and cheese sandwich, hash browns and a medium hot or iced coffee for $6.
deals.notes: Price may vary by location.

deals.title: 3x points for one day around your birthday
deals.details: Dunkin' Rewards members with a birthday on file get 3x points on purchases all day. Activate and use it on one day: the day before, the day of, or the day after your birthday. It's a points bonus, not a free item.
deals.notes: Add your birthday to your account to qualify, then activate the offer in the app. Once a year.

deals.title: Boosted Status: 100 bonus pts on orders after 1 PM
deals.details: Boosted Status Dunkin' Rewards members earn 100 bonus points on an order placed after 1 PM (offer runs 10/1–10/31/26). Activate it in the Dunkin' app, then order ahead, scan your Rewards ID in store, or pay with an enrolled Dunkin' card.
deals.notes: Boosted Status members only. Limit 100 bonus points per member per day. Bonus is earned on base points only and can't be combined with other offers. Participating US stores.

deals.title: Free birthday drink for Dutch Rewards members
deals.details: Dutch Rewards members get a free drink reward in the app on their birthday. If you download the app on your birthday, it arrives the next day. The reward is good for 30 days. There is no half-birthday reward (that ended Dec 1, 2023).
deals.notes: Your birthday has to be on your Dutch Rewards account.

deals.title: Free medium drink for joining Dutch Rewards
deals.details: New loyalty account registrations only: one free medium drink, which expires 14 days after you register. After that you earn 3 points per $1 spent. Gift card purchases and reloads, taxes, tips and donations earn no points. 250 points = free medium drink, and any other drink costs 325 points. Redeemed point drinks expire 180 days after you trade the points in, and points expire 180 days after they're earned.
deals.notes: You also get 1 free sticker (while supplies last) with every drink bought on the first Wednesday of each month; next is Wed Nov 4. San Antonio-area shops are in San Antonio, New Braunfels and Converse.

deals.title: Kids eat free Wednesdays 3-9 PM
deals.details: Every Wednesday 3-9 PM is kids eat free night at the Northside location. Purchase requirement, age limit and dine-in terms are not stated.
deals.location: 3755 Thousand Oaks Dr, San Antonio 78247 (Northside location only)
deals.sourceName: Eddie's Taco House - Northside Dinner page
deals.notes: The brand text dates to Dec 2023 but is still on the live site; one local source says 3-6 PM. The Downtown location closes at 2:30 PM and isn't included. Ask about the adult-purchase requirement: (210) 490-5500.

deals.title: Free chocolate-dipped fruit cone w/ email signup
deals.details: Join Edible's email list to get a coupon for a free chocolate-dipped fruit cone (listed as a $9.99 value). No purchase needed. Redeem in store only. The coupon expires 1 month after the offer email arrives. Hip2Save calls it a limited-time offer. If the signup button is greyed out, try another browser or device.
deals.notes: Only one deal site reports it (Oct 23, 2026), and no end date is announced. Stores are franchised, so call ahead to confirm your San Antonio-area store takes part.

deals.title: 6 bagels for $7 (Spooky Deal)
deals.details: Six fresh-baked bagels of your choice for $7 at participating locations. In the bakery, the brand page doesn't require Rewards. To order ahead in the app or online, you must be a Rewards member and add the Spooky Deal reward from My Rewards before adding items. In the bakery, Rewards members can give their phone number or scan the app barcode.
deals.notes: The Nov 3 end date comes from one deal site; the brand lists none. Locations include Alamo Ranch, Potranco Rd, W I-10 and Fredericksburg Rd; the Trinity University campus store may not take part.

deals.title: Free bagel & shmear w/ purchase for new members
deals.details: Sign up for Einstein Bros Rewards and get a free bagel & shmear with any purchase (no minimum stated). Redeem in-bakery or when ordering ahead online or in the app at participating locations. The reward applies once the eligible item is in your cart. Only 1 reward or offer per order.
deals.sourceName: Einstein Bros Rewards (brand page + Rewards FAQ)
deals.notes: The brand states no expiration. San Antonio stores include Alamo Ranch Pkwy, Potranco Rd, W I-10 and Fredericksburg Rd; the Trinity University campus location may not take part in rewards.

deals.title: Free birthday egg sandwich w/ purchase
deals.details: Einstein Bros Rewards members get a free egg sandwich with purchase for their birthday, valid for 14 days. Your birthday must be in your account, and the account must be active and in good standing. Redeem in-bakery or when ordering ahead online or in the app at participating locations. Only 1 reward or offer per order.
deals.notes: Unclear whether the 14 days start on your birthday or the day it's sent, or how far ahead you must add your birthday. The Trinity University campus location may not take part.

deals.title: Kids eat free Wednesdays, 5 PM-close
deals.details: Wednesdays 5 PM to close: one free kids meal per adult entree purchased. Alamo City Moms says kids 12 and under. Call ahead to confirm.
deals.location: 6498 N New Braunfels Ave, 78209 (Alamo Heights); 734 W Bitters Rd, 78216 (281 & Bitters)
deals.notes: Not mentioned on EZ's own site or menu. One local source says all locations, but the Potranco Rd location couldn't be confirmed. Runs until close (9 PM Sun-Thu).

deals.title: Free medium birthday sub w/ any purchase
deals.details: Firehouse Rewards members get a free medium sub with any purchase on their birthday. KCL says a $1+ purchase. KCL also says you must have made a purchase in the 6 months before your birthday, and that the offer is valid the day before, the day of and the day after your birthday. Participating locations; some franchise locations may opt out.
deals.sourceName: The Freebie Guy (updated Oct 14, 2026); The Krazy Coupon Lady (updated Oct 1, 2026)
deals.notes: Only one source gives the rule that you need a purchase in the prior 6 months and a 3-day redemption window; the brand site couldn't confirm it. Check the app.

deals.title: Kids eat free Sun & Tue w/ adult combo
deals.details: Sundays and Tuesdays: kids eat free with the purchase of an adult combo. The source doesn't give an age limit, how many kids each combo covers, or whether it's dine-in only. Participation varies by restaurant.
deals.location: Participating San Antonio-area Firehouse Subs (call ahead)
deals.sourceName: Alamo City Moms (current as of Aug 2026)
deals.notes: No source names which San Antonio stores take part, and the brand site didn't confirm it. Confirm with your local store before relying on it.

deals.title: Amex Offer: +4 MR pts/$ at Fleming's (to 5,000)
deals.details: Enroll in Amex Offers, then pay with the enrolled card. Earn an extra 4 Membership Rewards points per eligible $1, up to 5,000 bonus points (about $1,250 spend), on top of normal earn. Ends Sunday 10/25/26. San Antonio: 255 E Basse Rd, Suite 200, San Antonio, TX 78209, 210-824-9463. Hours Mon-Sat 11:00-22:00, Sun 11:00-21:00.
deals.notes: Targeted: check your account. Last year's (2025) terms covered in-restaurant and online pickup orders at order.flemingssteakhouse.com, and excluded catering, gift cards and third-party delivery. Check this year's offer terms in your account.

deals.title: Surprise birthday reward (Freddy's Rewards, 30 days)
deals.details: Add your birthday to your Freddy's Rewards account and you'll get a surprise reward on your birthday each year, usable within 30 days. If your birthday falls within 30 days of signing up, the first reward comes the following year. One reward per transaction, and promo codes can't be combined with rewards. Some nontraditional locations (airports, sports venues, college campuses) don't take part.
deals.notes: The brand doesn't say what the birthday reward is. San Antonio store addresses couldn't be confirmed, so check the app for nearby stores.

deals.title: Kids eat free Sat & Sun (code KIDSEATFREE online)
deals.details: Saturdays and Sundays, all day: one free kids meal (ages 12 and under) per adult entrée purchased. Dine in, or order online with promo code KIDSEATFREE (up to two free kids meals per online order). Participating locations.
deals.notes: Can't be combined with other offers. Not shown on Freebirds' own pages in this check. Call your store if unsure.

deals.title: Kids eat free weekdays 3 PM-close (code KIDSTIME online)
deals.details: Monday-Friday from 3 PM to close: one free kids meal (ages 12 and under) per adult entrée purchased. Dine in, or order online with promo code KIDSTIME (up to two free kids meals per online order). Participating locations only.
deals.notes: 2026 sources are Dallas-area; San Antonio participation in the weekday version isn't confirmed (Alamo City Moms lists only Sat/Sun). Closing time varies by store. Call ahead or test the code at online checkout.

deals.restaurant: Giftory (Olive Garden, Red Lobster, Five Guys, Dave & Buster's, Cheesecake Factory)
deals.title: $50 restaurant eGift cards for ~$42-$45 at Giftory
deals.details: Limited time on Giftory (third-party seller): $50 restaurant eGift cards with promo codes at checkout. Codes: OLIVE44 (Olive Garden), RL43 (Red Lobster), 5GUYS43 (Five Guys), DBGAME42 (Dave & Buster's), CF43 (Cheesecake Factory). Hip2Save prices them under $44-$45; it gives $45.50 as the final Cheesecake Factory price. eVouchers can be sent right away or scheduled.
deals.notes: One deal site reports inconsistent pricing ($43 to $45.50). No end date, so codes may stop working without notice. Giftory is a third-party reseller, not the restaurants.

deals.title: Birthday treat (Golden Chick Rewards)
deals.details: Registered Golden Chick Rewards members get 'a special treat on your birthday.' The Birthday Offer appears 7 days before your birthday and expires 23 days after it. You must register your phone number to redeem, and you can use only one reward per order. Participating locations only, so ask or call ahead.
deals.sourceName: Golden Chick Golden Rewards Terms & FAQ
deals.notes: The item isn't named, so check the app. Per the terms, it's usable from 7 days before to 23 days after your birthday. It's unconfirmed which San Antonio stores take part in rewards.

deals.title: Free chicken sandwich w/ first $10+ order
deals.details: Register for Golden Chick Rewards (app, website or Spendgo) to get a free Big & Golden or Big & Wicked chicken sandwich with your first $10 purchase. The Welcome Offer expires 60 days after it's earned. You must register your phone number to redeem, and you can use only one reward per order. Participating locations only, so ask or call ahead.
deals.sourceName: Golden Chick Golden Rewards Terms & FAQ
deals.notes: Golden Chick lists 8 San Antonio stores, but it's unconfirmed which take part in Golden Rewards. Check the app before you go.

deals.title: Up to $20 off 3 delivery orders, Grubhub+ app (APP100)
deals.details: Up to $20 off the food subtotal on each of up to 3 delivery orders (up to $60 total). Requires an active Grubhub+ membership. Grubhub app only, delivery orders only, $0.01 minimum subtotal. Taxes, government charges, fees and tips not covered. Not valid on alcohol, catering or scheduled group orders, and can't be combined with certain other discounts or cash. Limit 3 redemptions per user. Subject to restaurant and delivery availability; may be canceled at any time. Valid for orders placed 10/12/2026 12:01 AM to 11/01/2026 11:59 PM local time. Billed as being for first-time app users. Terms say it is for intended recipients only, so it is targeted.
deals.notes: Targeted, so results vary: in one forum thread 2 users said it worked and 3 got errors. Delivery fees can eat much of the discount (one user's $20 dropped to about $7 net). No Grubhub terms found.

deals.title: Capital One Offer: up to $50 back at HelloFresh
deals.details: Sign in to Capital One Offers, pick the HelloFresh offer, and follow its link. Complete the order in that same browser session within 24 hours, using a personal Capital One card. Listed as up to $50 cash back or 5,000 miles. The amount can change. Taxes, shipping and fees are excluded, and canceling or returning part of the order can void the payout. Can't be stacked with Rakuten. Rewards usually post in about 45 days (within 3 billing cycles).
deals.notes: Targeted offer, so check your own Capital One account. Only one source reports it and it lists no expiration or minimum spend. "Up to $50" may be a new-customer deal.

deals.title: $10.99 sandwich, 3 sliders or pot pie + chips + drink
deals.details: Get a sandwich, a 3-pack of sliders or a turkey pot pie, plus chips and a drink, for $10.99. In store, show the coupon from honeybaked.com/lunch-offer when you order. Online, use promo code 729678. Valid through Oct 31, 2026.

For military, it covers the check excluding alcohol and tax. Show valid ID, such as a Uniformed Services ID, retiree ID, LES, DD214, Veteran ID Card or veterans-organization card. Not available through online ordering: call in, show ID and pay at the restaurant. Cannot be combined with a Dine Rewards redemption, the AARP discount or catering.

deals.title: Kids Eat Free Mondays (1 free Joey meal per adult entree)

Not available through third-party delivery. Can't be combined with other offers. Tax and gratuity excluded. Product and participation vary by location.
deals.location: Participating San Antonio Outbacks: De Zavala (12511 I-10 W), City Base (2814 SE Military Dr), Ingram Rd (6569 Ingram Rd)

deals.title: Tuesday Tails: sirloin + lobster tail from $24.99
deals.details: Every Tuesday, get a 6oz Center-Cut Sirloin, a lobster tail and your choice of two steakhouse sides, starting at $24.99. Dine-in only.

deals.sourceName: Outback Steakhouse Weekday Value Offers page
deals.notes: Dine-in only. Price, product and participation vary by location, and 'starting at' means it may cost more locally, so call your store.

deals.title: Walkabout Wednesday: sirloin or chicken combo from $13.99

deals.sourceName: Outback Steakhouse Weekday Value Offers page

deals.title: Amex Offer: $10 back on $50+ at P.F. Chang's
deals.details: Enroll in Amex Offers, then spend $50 or more with the enrolled card to get $10 back. One use. San Antonio locations: 255 E Basse Rd, Suite 1200, San Antonio, TX 78209, (210) 507-1000; and La Cantera, 15900 La Cantera Pkwy, Bldg 1, Suite 1100, San Antonio, TX 78256, (210) 507-6500.

deals.title: Citi Offer: 5% back at P.F. Chang's
deals.details: Add the offer in Citi Merchant Offers before you buy, then pay with that same Citi card. 5% back on one purchase, on a transaction of up to $2,000 (so at most $100 back). One use unless the terms say otherwise. San Antonio locations: 255 E Basse Rd, Suite 1200 (78209) and 15900 La Cantera Pkwy, Bldg 1, Suite 1100 (78256). There is also one in New Braunfels.
deals.notes: Targeted: check your account. Only one source reports it; the listing showed an expiry of 11/15/26, which wasn't re-checked this time.

deals.title: Free birthday appetizer or dessert (Rewards)
deals.details: Rewards members who add a birth month and day to their profile get a free appetizer or dessert. Give your server your Rewards ID, email or phone number to redeem; good for 30 days after your birthday.
deals.notes: Excludes catering-menu appetizers and desserts and dessert cocktails. One-time use, participating locations only.

deals.title: Free edamame on dine-in visits for Rewards members
deals.details: P.F. Chang's Rewards members get complimentary edamame when they dine in. Joining Rewards is free.
deals.notes: Dine-in only. Not valid on third-party delivery orders.

deals.title: 1,000 free chicken fajita plates, 4-6 p.m.
deals.details: The first 1,000 customers get a free chicken fajita plate from 4 to 6 p.m., while supplies last. Only at the Zarzamora Street location, not the McCullough Ave (Olmos Park) one. Held in honor of co-founder Evelyn Sepulveda Reyes, who opened Panchito's with her husband Roy in 1980.
deals.location: 1705 S Zarzamora St, San Antonio, TX 78207
deals.notes: MySA's full article (Oct 22, 2026) quotes Panchito's Facebook announcement from Oct 21. Limited to 1,000 plates, so arrive early. Any per-person limit and dine-in vs. to-go aren't stated.

deals.title: Birthday gift: choose from several options
deals.details: Panda Rewards members choose a birthday gift from a selection of options. Panda says it's a purchase-based offer, so a purchase is required. KCL lists a small a la carte entree, a small appetizer or a medium a la carte side. Redeem through your Panda Rewards account.
deals.notes: Requires a purchase. The specific gift choices come only from The Krazy Coupon Lady, and how long the reward lasts isn't stated, so check the app.

deals.title: Wok Wednesday: play game for a weekly reward
deals.details: Every Wednesday, Panda Rewards members can play the Wok Wednesday game in the app or at pandaexpress.com/app/wok-wednesday to get one offer. Offers are set by an algorithm and vary. One per member per week, one-time use.
deals.notes: Requires Panda Rewards. The offer expires the same Wednesday at your store's closing time. Prizes vary and may be a discount rather than free food. Panda can end it anytime.

deals.title: $2 off barista coffee w/ any purchase (FALLFAV2)
deals.details: $2 off a barista-crafted coffee with any purchase. Expires 10/31/2026. The code comes from Panera paper coupons posted on Slickdeals 2026-10-22. The channels and any MyPanera requirement aren't stated.
deals.notes: Mailer codes are often regional. The Slickdeals post is poorly rated with no confirmation the code works, and it isn't verified for San Antonio. Test it at checkout.

deals.title: $3 off full-size soup/salad/sandwich (SAVESFALL)
deals.details: $3 off any full-size soup, salad, sandwich or You Pick Two. Expires 10/31/2026. The code comes from Panera paper coupons posted on Slickdeals 2026-10-22. It's unclear whether MyPanera is required, whether it's for new or existing customers, which channels it works on, and whether it can be combined with other offers.
deals.notes: Mailer codes are often regional. The Slickdeals post is poorly rated with no confirmation the code works, and it isn't verified for San Antonio. Test it at checkout.

deals.title: 25% off online or in-app order (ONLINE25DEAL)
deals.details: 25% off your next online or in-app order. Expires 10/31/2026. The code comes from Panera paper coupons posted on Slickdeals 2026-10-22. No maximum discount, minimum spend, MyPanera requirement or new/existing customer limit is stated.
deals.notes: Mailer codes are often regional. The Slickdeals post is poorly rated with no confirmation the code works, and it isn't verified for San Antonio. Don't confuse it with the expired ONLINE25 code.

deals.title: 500 bonus points with first MyPanera purchase
deals.details: Join MyPanera for free and get 500 bonus points with your first purchase. The offer is good for 14 days. Points can go toward free items; 250 points gets a free bagel or mini bakery treat.
deals.notes: Purchase required, and the welcome offer is valid for 14 days. The free bakery treat is a birthday reward, not a sign-up reward.

deals.title: Buy one entrée, get a second for $5 (BOGO5)
deals.details: Buy one eligible item, get a second eligible item for $5 (the discount applies to the lower-priced item). Eligible: whole sandwich, whole salad, whole market bowl, salad stuffer, bowl of soup, bowl of mac & cheese. Enter BOGO5 at checkout; one use per transaction. Excludes breakfast, You Pick Two, Mix & Match Menu, Family Feasts, Kids' Meals, lobster items, catering and third-party delivery orders. Upcharges for modifications still apply. Not valid with other offers. Delivery has an $8-10 minimum and higher menu prices plus fees. Participating US cafes only, while supplies last.
deals.notes: Limited time with no published dates; Panera may end it without notice. Enter the code at online checkout. One site says a MyPanera account is needed and the code worked at most, not all, locations.

deals.title: Free birthday bakery treat (MyPanera)
deals.details: MyPanera members with a birthday on file get a free bakery treat (pastry or sweet) or a bagel. The reward loads to your account on your birthday and can be redeemed for 7 days after it's issued.
deals.notes: Panera's own pages couldn't confirm it. Reported as a free pastry or sweet (some sources add a bagel) that lasts about 7 days after it's issued. Check the MyPanera app.

deals.title: 25% off regular-priced order, code SM25
deals.details: 25% off a regular-priced order. Enter SM25 at checkout on papajohns.com or in the app. Papa Johns' general terms: participating U.S. restaurants only, not valid with other coupons or discounts, some offers online only, delivery fee not discounted. EatDrinkDeals also lists a $8.99 large 1-topping pizza for carryout only (limited time) and Papa Pairings at $6.99 each when you choose two or more items. Prices vary by location.
deals.notes: No expiration given. Prices vary by location, and one listing gives conflicting carryout prices ($8 vs. $8.99 for a large 1-topping). Papa Johns' own specials page showed no offers.

deals.title: $10 large Jack-O-Lantern pizza
deals.details: A large Jack-O-Lantern pizza is $10, on Original crust only. Take-and-bake. No substitutions or additional toppings. Can't be combined with any other offer, special, promotion or discount. In-store Family Size prices may vary, and dairy-free cheese may cost extra. You can also pair it with Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough in the 'Scream of a Deal' bundle, which the Krazy Coupon Lady says is $15. Participating locations, online or in store.
deals.location: 938 Wurzbach Pkwy, San Antonio, TX 78231, (210) 408-8060, open 11:00-20:00 daily (also 606 S Walnut Ave, New Braunfels)
deals.notes: Runs through Oct 31, 2026. The $15 bundle price comes from one coupon site only. Couldn't confirm the Wurzbach store is participating, so call ahead.

deals.title: Kids 12 & under eat free Mondays (Alamo Ranch only)
deals.details: Mondays, all day: kids 12 and under eat free. Alamo Ranch location only. The source doesn't say whether an adult purchase is required or how many kids per adult.
deals.location: Alamo Ranch location only, San Antonio (street address not verified)
deals.sourceName: Alamo City Moms (list current as of Aug 2026)
deals.notes: Only one secondary source reports it. Address, hours, purchase requirement and per-adult limit are unknown, so call the Alamo Ranch store first.

deals.title: Amex Offer: 1,500 MR pts on $30+ at Peet's
deals.details: Add the offer to your card in Amex Offers before you buy, then spend $30 or more in one purchase with that card to earn 1,500 Membership Rewards points. One use. It needs a card that earns Membership Rewards (for example Gold or Platinum).
deals.notes: Targeted: check your account. It may appear on Platinum or other Membership Rewards cards. No San Antonio Peet's cafe was found, so it likely works only for peets.com orders, which isn't confirmed.

deals.title: Citi Offer: 5% back at Pei Wei
deals.details: Add the Citi Merchant Offer to your Citi card, then pay with it at Pei Wei to get 5% back as a statement credit. Upgraded Points says the reward is capped at a $2,000 transaction and the offer expires Nov 15, 2026.
deals.notes: Targeted: check your account.

deals.title: Free small birthday appetizer + free entrée on signup
deals.details: For your birthday, choose a free small appetizer: Crab Wontons (2), small Traditional Edamame, 1 Vegetable Spring Roll or 1 Pork Egg Roll. New members get a free regular entrée on their next visit after a first purchase of at least $8 before tax.
deals.notes: The birthday reward loads 7 days before your birthday and is valid for 14 days. The free entrée excludes salads, appetizers, kids meals and add-ons. Participating locations only.

deals.title: Buy $50 gift card, get $10 bonus card
deals.details: Buy a $50 gift card and get a $10 bonus card. The bonus card is valid 11/1/26-12/1/26 only. Per Peter Piper's gift card FAQ, not every location accepts bonus cards, and bonus cards may have expiration dates; check the bonus card's terms for participating locations before buying.
deals.notes: End date isn't stated; it likely runs through Oct 31 with the Halloween promos, but that's inferred. Unknown if it's online or in store, or if San Antonio locations take part. Check with your store.

deals.title: $3 Personal Pan Pizza Tuesdays
deals.details: $3 one-topping Personal Pan Pizza every Tuesday, while supplies last. Limit 4 per customer, and it can't be combined with other offers. Order in store, in the app or at pizzahut.com.
deals.sourceName: Pizza Hut - $3 Personal Pan Pizza page
deals.notes: Participating locations only, while supplies last. Pizza Hut says it's valid for delivery and carryout, but some deal sites say carryout only, so check with your San Antonio store.

deals.title: Big Hut Deal: large 3-topping pizza for $10
deals.details: A large three-topping pizza with your choice of Hut Crust for $10. Also the Triple Treat Box GameDay Edition: 2 medium 1-topping pizzas, 5 breadsticks and 10 cinnamon sticks from $21.99.
deals.notes: Football-season promo that launched Aug 25, 2026 for a limited time, with no end date published. A commercial from Oct 21 lists the Big Hut Deal at $10.99, so check the price in the app. Participating locations; prices vary.

deals.title: My Haunt Box from $6.99
deals.details: Halloween version of the My Hut Box, starting at $6.99. Pick an entrée (six wings, a Personal Pan Pizza or a melt) and a side (fries or four wings). A drink, including limited-edition Mountain Dew x Trolli Mango Pineapple Punch, costs extra. Prices vary by market (e.g., $8.49 box and $2 drink in Los Angeles). Participating locations.

deals.title: $13 weekday lunch specials, 11 AM-2:30 PM (dine-in)

deals.details: Every Thursday: all-you-can-eat Buffalo Bites. Same day: $1 off Bud Light and Michelob Ultra pints, and $5.50 8 oz frozen Regular-ritas.
deals.location: SA-area: Selma, North Star, Alamo Ranch, Brooks, Landmark
deals.notes: The menu lists no price, hours or dine-in rule for the AYCE Buffalo Bites. Ask the store. AYCE is normally dine-in only, but Pluckers doesn't say so.

deals.title: Kids eat free every Tuesday
deals.details: Every Tuesday: 2 free kids meals (ages 10 and under) with each adult entrée purchased. Dine-in only. Listed as a Tuesday special at the San Antonio-area Alamo Ranch (11202 Alamo Ranch Pkwy), Brooks (2714 SE Military Dr) and Selma (14881 I-35 N) stores.
deals.notes: Ongoing with no end date. San Antonio location pages say only "Kids Eat Free!" with no fine print, so ask your store about limits. On Oct 27 a separate promo adds a candy bag.

deals.title: Students: 20 wings for $20 on Saturdays 11am-2pm
deals.details: Every Saturday 11am-2pm: 20 wings for $20 ($10 per person). Each student needs a valid high-school or college ID, and there's a 2-guest minimum. Dine-in only. deals.details: Popeyes Rewards members get a free Classic or Spicy Chicken Sandwich, 2-pc Signature Chicken, 3-pc Tenders or 6-pc Wings on their first popeyes.com or app order of $10+ (before taxes and fees). Must be signed in to redeem; no code. Participating U.S. restaurants.
deals.notes: First digital order only; Rewards account required. No end date announced.

deals.title: Rewards: 2 chicken sandwiches $9 / 12 wings $12
deals.details: Popeyes Rewards members: two chicken sandwiches for $9 (app-exclusive), or 12 bone-in or boneless wings (or 12 tenders) for $12 on online or in-app orders. Rewards membership required. Offers may vary by account and location.

deals.title: Free birthday chips & queso (entree at Gold)

deals.title: Birthday reward for Caniac Club members
deals.details: Registered Caniac Club members get a birthday offer. The brand's terms give a free drink as an example, and the actual item may vary. Check the Raising Cane's app or your Caniac Club account near your birthday. Participating locations.

deals.title: Free kids meal Wednesdays 4-9 PM
deals.details: Wednesdays 4-9 PM: 1 free kids meal per regular-price adult entree, which must be a craft pizza or craft salad as part of a full adult meal. Kids meal: half a cheese or pepperoni pizza, a 12 oz fountain drink or Fruit Shoot, and a cookie. Dine-in only. Child must be present in-store.

deals.title: Birthday reward + 20% off first order (Red Lobster Nation)
deals.details: Red Lobster Nation members get a birthday reward, and new members get 20% off their first order. Red Lobster doesn't name the birthday item on the rewards page; older reports say it's a free dessert.
deals.notes: The birthday item and any purchase requirement aren't published. Rewards aren't valid on third-party delivery or catering. Check the app near your birthday.

deals.title: Free appetizer w/ $10+ for new Royalty members
deals.details: Join Red Robin Royalty and get one free appetizer with a $10 minimum purchase. Alcohol, merchandise, gift cards, catering and tax don't count toward the minimum. deals.title: Kids' birthday: $7 off w/ $4.99+ purchase (dine-in)
deals.details: Royalty members who add a child's birthday (age 17 or under) get $7.00 off the check with a minimum accompanying $4.99 purchase. deals.title: Kids eat free Tue & Wed 4-8 PM (dine-in)
deals.details: Tuesdays and Wednesdays, 4-8 PM: one free kid's meal per adult purchase. The drink is not included. Fun4AlamoKids says the deal is dine-in only and for kids 9 and under. Phone (210) 691-2070.
deals.location: 5999 De Zavala Rd, Ste 111, San Antonio, TX 78249
deals.sourceName: Rome's Pizza specials page; MySA via Yahoo (Aug 2026); Fun4AlamoKids
deals.notes: The brand page lists no age limit or dine-in rule; those come from local family-deal sites. Specials may change without notice, and one site says 4 PM to close while the brand says 4-8 PM.

deals.title: $7 Spurs Meal Deal ticket add-on (Fri-Sun games)
deals.details: A $7 add-on to a Spurs home-game ticket for Friday-Sunday home games: a value soda plus a hot dog or nachos. Add it when buying the ticket through Spurs.com or the official Ticketmaster offer, then redeem at the arena. Sunday-Thursday home games instead offer a $7 souvenir draft beer add-on (21+, valid ID required).
deals.location: Frost Bank Center, 1 Frost Bank Center Dr, San Antonio
deals.notes: Valid only on Fri-Sun home games: Oct 31 vs Minnesota, Nov 13 vs Golden State, Nov 21 vs New Orleans, Nov 27 vs LA Lakers. The full schedule wasn't checked, so there may be others.

deals.title: Kids eat free Tuesdays (dine-in)

deals.title: $5 off $10+ for new Schlotzsky's Rewards members

Service fees apply to online, in-app and some call-in orders.
deals.notes: No end date given.

deals.title: BOGO Wednesday: free pizza, flatbread or calzone
deals.details: Every Wednesday, all day: buy a pizza, flatbread or calzone and get a second free. The free item must be of equal or lesser value. Excludes Kids' Pizzas. Extra toppings and gluten-free crust are not covered.

deals.title: Free small sandwich w/ purchase on birthday
deals.details: Schlotzsky's Rewards members get a free small sandwich with a purchase for their birthday. The Freebie Guy says the minimum is $1; KCL says any purchase. You need your birthday on file in the Schlotzsky's app account, and it can't be changed once set. Participating locations.

deals.title: Pizzas from $5 after 5 PM Fri-Sun

deals.title: Birthday bonus Smiles (200-400) in Scooter's app
deals.details: Scooter's Rewards app members get birthday Smiles based on their highest status in the past 6 months: 200 at Buddy, 300 at Bestie, 400 at Ride-or-Die. They're loaded one day before your birthday and can be redeemed for free drinks, treats and more.
