deals.title: SHACKSUNDAY: free Chicken Shack w/ $10+ (Sundays)
deals.details: Every Sunday through Dec 27, 2026: a free Chicken Shack with a $10+ purchase (the $10 is for other items) using code SHACKSUNDAY. Some sources say you can choose a single ShackBurger or 6-pc chicken bites instead. Order on shakeshack.com, in the Shake Shack app or at an in-Shack kiosk, signed into your Shake Shack account (also shown under 'View My Available Offers'). Not valid on third-party delivery.
deals.notes: Sources disagree on whether the free item is just the Chicken Shack or any of three. First valid Sunday is Oct 25. Check that your local San Antonio Shack takes part.

deals.title: 2 free Glazed donuts for joining Shipley Rewards
deals.details: Join Shipley Rewards (in the app or at shipleydonuts.com/rewards) and get 2 free Glazed Donuts. Members earn 5 points per $1 spent, in store or online. A free half-dozen Glazed costs 350 points. Birthday reward: either a free donut (1 Glazed or Iced) or a free half-dozen (Glazed or Iced), depending on tier. Anniversary reward: a free donut or specialty roll. Tiers: Glazed, Filled, Iced, Sprinkles.
deals.notes: Shipley doesn't say how long the sign-up reward lasts or whether it's redeemed in store, online or both. Offers may apply only at participating locations.

deals.title: Free birthday donut(s) (Shipley Rewards)
deals.details: Shipley Rewards members get a free birthday reward. The brand lists both '1 Glazed or Iced donut of your choosing' and 'a free 1/2 dozen donuts (Glazed or Iced),' apparently depending on rewards tier (Glazed 1-999 pts, Filled 1,000-1,999, Iced 2,000-2,999, Sprinkles 3,000+). Redeem in the Shipley app (scan in-store or order online).
deals.notes: Shipley doesn't say which tier gets 1 donut versus a half dozen, how long the reward lasts, or when it's issued. May vary by franchised store.

deals.title: Weekly $0.99 coffee for Rewards members
deals.details: Shipley Rewards member perk: a $0.99 coffee once a week. In store only. You need a Shipley Rewards account.
deals.notes: Coffee size, eligible tiers and the day the week resets aren't listed, and a footnote may add conditions. May apply only at participating locations.

deals.title: Kids 10 & under eat free Wednesdays
deals.details: Wednesdays: kids 10 and under eat free from the Kids Menu. One adult entree must be purchased for each free kids menu item. Kids Menu items only.
deals.location: Leon Valley: 8910 Bandera Rd Ste 305 (78250); Alamo Ranch: 11975 Alamo Ranch Pkwy Ste 110 (78253); Stone Oak: 700 E Sonterra Blvd Ste 1117 (78258)
deals.notes: The promotion doesn't state hours; noon-9 PM is the restaurant's Wednesday opening hours. Dine-in restriction not stated.

deals.title: $2 birthday smoothie (free for Champion tier)
deals.details: Healthy Rewards (base tier) members get a 20 oz smoothie for $2 as a birthday bonus. Champion-tier members get a free 20 oz smoothie, loaded to their account. You need a Smoothie King app account with your birthday on file. Participating locations.
deals.notes: The brand page doesn't say how long you have to redeem it or whether $2 is the price or a discount. One coupon site says it's free for all members, but the brand page says $2 for the base tier.

deals.title: Chicken Flatbread + 20 oz smoothie bundle from $9.99
deals.details: Any Chicken Flatbread (chipotle, ranch or pesto sauce) plus a 20 oz Fruit Classic Smoothie, starting at $9.99. Pricing varies by location.
deals.notes: No end date is listed, so it's treated as ongoing. $9.99 is a starting price; San Antonio stores may charge more.

deals.title: Free Friday upsize 20 oz to 32 oz (Rewards)
deals.details: On Fridays, Smoothie King Healthy Rewards members get a 32 oz smoothie for the price of a 20 oz. Redeem through the Smoothie King app at participating locations.
deals.notes: Only a deal site confirms this. It cites Smoothie King's rewards page, but this check couldn't load that page. In summer 2025 the upsize was open to everyone, so the terms may have changed. Check the app before going.

deals.title: Weekly free food pantry for military & veterans
deals.details: Weekly Military & Veteran Food Pantry, run with Boeing. It is open every Friday EXCEPT the 3rd Friday of the month. It serves military and veteran families facing food insecurity. You must register each month at https://soldiersangels.tfaforms.net/20.
deals.location: 1355 Central Pkwy S #700, San Antonio, TX 78232
deals.notes: Need-based food assistance on Fridays, except the 3rd Friday of each month: Oct 30, Nov 6, 13 and 27 (dates worked out from the rule). Holiday closures aren't stated, so confirm with the organization.

deals.title: $2 snacks for Sonic Rewards members, 2-5 PM
deals.details: Sonic Rewards members can get one snack for $2: a corn dog, small mozzarella sticks, small tots, small premium chicken bites, or small Groovy fries. Available daily 2-5 PM local time. Good once per day. Must be redeemed online or in the Sonic app while signed in as a registered member. Participating locations.
deals.notes: Sonic's own pages didn't confirm this, and related $1 snack deals may be stale. It may be a personalized offer, so check the Offers tab in the Sonic app.

deals.title: Half-price single cheeseburgers Tuesdays after 5 p.m.
deals.details: 50% off the menu price of single-patty cheeseburgers (about 1/4 lb precooked) on Tuesdays from 5 p.m. local time until close. You must order in the Sonic app or online as a registered user; the discount applies automatically. Add-ons cost extra. Not valid with combos, delivery, or any other offer. Mobile ordering is only at select locations, and hours vary. Participating locations.
deals.notes: Needs a registered Sonic account (app or online). One weak source says Signature Slingers, Jr. burgers and Quarter Pound Doubles are excluded.

deals.title: Happy Hour: half-price drinks & slushes 2-4 PM
deals.details: Daily 2-4 PM at participating locations: half-price soft drinks, iced teas, lemonades and limeades (regular or frozen), Ocean Water and slushes. Add-ins cost extra.
deals.notes: Participating locations only, and Sonic's terms call it limited-time. Deal sites also say Rewards members get the half-price pricing all day by ordering in the Sonic app. No 2026 Sonic source was checked, so call your local drive-in first.

deals.title: SONIC Rewards welcome reward: free medium fries, tots or drink
deals.details: New SONIC Rewards members (free sign-up in the SONIC app) get a welcome reward: their choice of a Medium Fries, Tots, or a Drink. Existing SONIC app users don't re-register; they just update the app. Members earn 10 points per $1 (11 at Star tier, 12 at Legend).
deals.notes: The reward is a choice of medium fries, tots or a drink, not a burger. Sonic doesn't say whether a purchase is needed or when it expires.

deals.title: Kids eat free Thursdays (all day)
deals.details: Thursdays all day: kids eat free with every adult purchase. No age limit is stated. Call (830) 438-1888 to confirm.
deals.location: 112 W Specht Rd, San Antonio, TX 78260
deals.notes: The restaurant's site lists Thursday hours as 11 AM-8 PM and says it's closed Mon-Tue. Its homepage has also advertised a magician on kids-eat-free Thursdays.

deals.title: Free birthday drink or food (Starbucks Rewards)
deals.details: Birthday Reward: one free handcrafted beverage, one free food item, or one free ready-to-drink bottled beverage. Green members can use it only on the birthday itself. Gold members (500 Stars in 12 months) get 7 days and Reserve members (2,500 Stars in 12 months) get 30 days, both starting on the birthday. To qualify you must join Starbucks Rewards at least 7 days before your birthday, have your birthday in your account, and make at least one Star-earning transaction before your birthday each year. Excludes multi-serve items (such as a Coffee Traveler or tray of bars), alcoholic drinks, merchandise and packaged coffee. Participating stores only.
deals.sourceName: Starbucks Rewards Terms of Use (effective Mar 10, 2026)

deals.title: New Rewards members: 50% off a handcrafted drink
deals.details: New Starbucks Rewards members get 50% off one handcrafted drink, valid for 7 days after sign-up. Limit one per member, at participating stores. Excludes delivery orders, alcohol, and ready-to-drink or bottled drinks. Join in the Starbucks app or at starbucks.com.
deals.notes: Starbucks' own pages didn't confirm this. Groupon describes the new-member offer differently: a free handcrafted drink up to $8 with a qualifying purchase in the first week. Check which offer shows in the app after you join.

deals.title: 2 Footlongs for $12.99 (1299FOR2)
deals.details: Two footlong subs for $12.99. Same deal as code 1299FL. Requires a free Sub Club membership. Add the eligible footlongs to your cart, then apply the code at checkout on subway.com or in the app, with in-restaurant pickup. Select stores only. Limited time, while supplies last.
deals.sourceName: The Freebie Guy (Oct 2026); Fat Kid Deals on X
deals.notes: Valid through Nov 15, 2026 per The Freebie Guy and Slickdeals. Not all stores take it, and whether this or the $13.99 code works varies by store. The website was reported more reliable than the app.

deals.title: 2 Footlongs for $13.99 (1399FOR2)
deals.details: Two footlong subs for $13.99. Same deal as code 1399FL. Requires a free Sub Club membership. Add the eligible footlongs to your cart, then apply the code at checkout on subway.com or in the app, with in-restaurant pickup. Select stores only. Limited time, while supplies last.
deals.notes: Valid through Nov 15, 2026 per The Freebie Guy and Slickdeals. Whether this or the $12.99 code works varies by store. The website was reported more reliable than the app.

deals.title: 6" Sub Meal for $6.49 (649FORMEAL)
deals.details: 6-inch sub meal (sub, chips and drink) for $6.49. Requires a free Sub Club membership. Add the eligible meal to your cart, then apply the code at checkout on subway.com or in the app, with in-restaurant pickup. Select stores only. Limited time, while supplies last.
deals.sourceName: The Freebie Guy (Oct 2026); Fat Kid Deals on X
deals.notes: Valid through Nov 15, 2026 per The Freebie Guy and Slickdeals. Not all stores take it. The website was reported more reliable than the app (Oct 22 comment).

deals.title: 6" Sub with Drink for $3.99 (6INSUB)
deals.details: 6-inch sub with a drink for $3.99. Requires a free Sub Club membership. Add the eligible items to your cart, then apply the code at checkout on subway.com or in the app, with in-restaurant pickup. Select stores only. Limited time, while supplies last.
deals.notes: Valid through Nov 15, 2026 per one source; no one has confirmed this specific code. The website was reported more reliable than the app.

deals.title: Footlong for $6.99 (FOOTLONG699)
deals.details: Footlong sub for $6.99. Alternate code to 699FORFTL. Requires a free Sub Club membership. Add an eligible footlong to your cart first, then apply the code at checkout on subway.com or in the Subway app, with in-restaurant pickup. Select stores only, and not every code works at every store. Limited time, while supplies last.
deals.notes: Valid through Nov 15, 2026 per one source. A commenter said codes work on the website but a recent app update broke most of them, and many local stores won't accept codes.

deals.title: Footlong for $7.99 (799FORFTL)
deals.details: Footlong sub for $7.99. Requires a free Sub Club membership. Add an eligible footlong to your cart, then apply the code at checkout on subway.com or in the app, with in-restaurant pickup. Select stores only, and codes may not work at every store. Limited time, while supplies last.
deals.notes: Valid through Nov 15, 2026 per Slickdeals. Also listed by Fat Kid Deals on X (Oct 13, 2026) as the alternate to 699FORFTL, and by DealsFinders (last seen Oct 22, 2026). Subway hasn't confirmed it. Try the website, which was reported more reliable than the app.

deals.title: Footlong Sub Meal for $8.99 (MEALFTL)
deals.details: Footlong meal (footlong, bag of chips and 20 oz fountain drink) for $8.99. Requires a free Sub Club membership; add all three items to your cart, then apply the code at checkout on subway.com or in the app with in-restaurant pickup. Select stores only; limited time.
deals.notes: Valid through Nov 15, 2026 per Slickdeals. Also listed by Fat Kid Deals on X (Oct 13, 2026) and DealsFinders. Subway hasn't confirmed it. If the code fails, add the chips and drink separately instead of using "Make It A Meal." The website was reported more reliable than the app (Oct 22 comment).

deals.title: Happy Hour: BOGO 50% off footlong (BOGO50)
deals.details: Buy one footlong and get a second half off with code BOGO50 online or in the app. Runs weekdays 4 PM to close and all day Saturday and Sunday.
deals.notes: Mon-Fri only from 4 PM to close; Sat-Sun all day. No end date published. Reported in two Sporked articles (Oct 2026).

deals.title: Promo codes: $6.99 Footlong, 2 for $12.99 & more
deals.details: Codes for Subway app or Subway.com orders only. Footlong: 699FORFTL ($6.99), 799FORFTL ($7.99), 899FL ($8.99). Two Footlongs: 1299FOR2 ($12.99), 1399FOR2 ($13.99), 2FOR1699 ($16.99). 6-inch with any drink purchase: 6INSUB ($3.99), 499FOR6IN ($4.99), 599SIXINCH ($5.99). 6-inch meal: 649FORMEAL ($6.49), 699MEAL ($6.99), 799FORMEAL ($7.99). Footlong meal: MEALFTL ($8.99), 999MEAL ($9.99), 1099FORMEAL ($10.99). Limited time; not every location accepts them.
deals.notes: Subway hasn't confirmed these. Fat Kid Deals on X (Oct 13, 2026) also lists 699FORFTL, 799FORFTL, MEALFTL, 649FORMEAL and 1299FOR2 for Oct-Nov. Codes overlap on price, so try the cheapest first; what works varies by store. Likely not combinable with the Sub Club BOGO (Oct 27-Nov 8).

deals.title: Free Baja Blast Freeze for your birthday (app)
deals.details: Taco Bell Rewards members get a free regular Mountain Dew Baja Blast Freeze as a birthday reward, used with an in-app order. You need a Taco Bell Rewards account with your birthday on file. Participating locations.
deals.sourceName: The Krazy Coupon Lady (updated Oct 1, 2026); The Freebie Guy (updated Oct 14, 2026)
deals.notes: Timing is unclear: one source says on your birthday, another says during your birthday month. Taco Bell's own pages didn't confirm it, so check the app.

deals.title: Double Happy Hour Sun-Thu: $3 bites, $2.50 margaritas
deals.details: Sunday-Thursday, 3-6 PM, plus a late-night window (9 PM-2 AM at launch; Taco Cabana's Sept 2026 release said 9-11 PM). Bean & Cheese Nachos $3, 3-Pack Chicken Flautas $3, Loaded Fries with Carne Asada $3, Margaritas $2.50 (21+), Cabana Refreshers $2.50, Strawberry Margarita Pie $1 at Texas locations including San Antonio.
deals.sourceName: Taco Cabana: 'Doubling down on value with our NEW Double Happy Hour' (Dec 22, 2025)
deals.notes: Covers the 3-6 PM window only. The late window may now end at 11 PM instead of 2 AM: Taco Cabana's Sept 2026 release listed 9-11 PM, daily during September. A happy-hour listing site shows $3 margaritas at 8315 Bandera Rd, so prices may vary by store. Confirm before you go.

deals.title: MY TC! Rewards sign-up: 2 free tacos
deals.details: Join MY TC! Rewards in the Taco Cabana app (Texas only). Link your card in the app and make a minimum $5 purchase. Redeem your first free taco, which unlocks the second one. Members earn 1 point per $1 on food and alcohol, by linked card or by uploading a receipt photo.
deals.notes: Taco Cabana's page doesn't say which tacos are free or when the bonus expires. Currently redeemable only in Texas.

deals.title: Free Pirata or taco + 50 pts for joining Rewards
deals.details: Register for Taco P Rewards (website or Eat Taco Palenque app; verify your phone with a 6-digit code) to get a free Pirata or Taco plus 50 bonus points. The free item expires 90 days after it's earned. Earn 1 point per $1 of subtotal (excludes tax, tips, gift cards); 125 points = $6 off (that reward expires 90 days after it's earned); points themselves never expire. One reward/discount per order. Works on web, app, and at participating locations by giving your phone number to the cashier. Guest checkout earns nothing.
deals.notes: In-store earning and redemption at participating locations only.

deals.title: Free Tres Leches for your birthday
deals.details: Taco P Rewards members get a free signature Tres Leches, valid from 7 days before through 21 days after their birthday. Requires full account registration. One reward/discount per order. Redeem on web, app, or at participating locations by giving your phone number to the cashier.
deals.notes: The page doesn't say how far before your birthday you must sign up or set your birthdate. It also doesn't say whether it's a slice or a whole cake.

deals.title: Free birthday appetizer or ribs/shrimp sidekick (VIP Club)
deals.details: VIP Club members get a free appetizer or a sidekick of ribs (some sources say ribs or shrimp) with an entrée purchase for their birthday. Join the VIP Club and add your birthday.
deals.notes: Purchase of an entrée required. Some sources say the reward is valid during your birthday month. The offer arrives by email.

deals.title: Welcome gift for joining the VIP Club
deals.details: New VIP Club (email) members get a welcome gift within 48 hours of signing up. The page doesn't say what the gift is. Sign up on the VIP Club page and pick a favorite location.
deals.notes: The gift isn't named and arrives by email.

deals.title: Free birthday slice w/ any purchase (Cheesecake Rewards)
deals.details: Free slice of cheesecake or layer cake with any food or beverage purchase (gift cards don't count). The reward is issued 7 days before your birthday and expires 7 days after it. If you join within 7 days of your birthday, it's issued on the birthday. One per year, one-time use, one per guest per visit, subject to availability. You must be present to redeem. Dine-in: tell your server before paying and give the phone number on your account. Pickup: tell the restaurant when you order, or apply the reward in the cart for online pickup. Not valid on delivery. Free to join, no points.
deals.sourceName: Cheesecake Rewards Terms and Conditions (brand page)
deals.notes: Available at The Shops at La Cantera and North Star Mall. The window runs from 7 days before to 7 days after your birthday.

deals.title: Free kids meal Tuesdays after 5 PM
deals.details: Tuesdays after 5 PM: one free child's meal with an adult entree purchase. The Cove's kids menu is for 12 and under. Call (210) 227-2683 to confirm.
deals.location: 606 W Cypress St, San Antonio, TX 78212
deals.notes: The Cove's specials page says specials are being updated and doesn't list this deal, so it may have changed. Confirm before you go. The 9 PM end matches its Tuesday closing time.

deals.title: Half-price nachos Tuesdays
deals.details: Tuesdays: nachos are half price. Regular prices: Bean & Cheese $10, Chicken Ranch $11, Steak $12, Street Corn $10. Add-ons cost extra: salsa +$1, guac +$2, jalapenos +$1, sour cream +$1, pico +$1. The venue and kitchen are open noon to midnight daily. The #FriendlyHour happy hour runs 'every hour, every day'; no item list is given.
deals.location: 943 S Alamo St, San Antonio, TX 78205
deals.notes: The site doesn't say whether the deal is all day, dine-in only, or whether add-ons are discounted. Daily specials are posted on Instagram @TheFriendlySpot.

deals.restaurant: Too Good To Go (various San Antonio businesses)
deals.title: Surprise Bags of unsold food at ~1/3 retail value
deals.details: Reserve and prepay in the Too Good To Go app, then pick up during the store's set window. Contents are a surprise. Bags sell for about one-third of retail value and are limited in number, so popular ones sell out. San Antonio participants seen: Whole Foods stores (2024 prices: $9.99 prepared-foods bag worth $30, $6.99 bakery bag worth $21, pickup usually in the hour before closing), a Circle K near the AT&T Center ($3.99 bag worth $12), and Pasha (a 2023 launch partner).
deals.sourceName: Too Good To Go Texas launch press release; Axios San Antonio
deals.notes: Prices come from 2023-2024 sources and may have changed. Current San Antonio partners and pickup windows weren't checked, so look in the app for what's near you.

deals.title: Birthday gift for Torchy's Rewards members (queso?)
deals.details: Torchy's Rewards members 'receive gifts on your birthday.' One birthday reward per year, based on the birthdate on your account. That birthdate can't be changed after you enroll. Rewards generally expire 14-30 days after issue. One reward redemption per transaction.
deals.notes: A banner asks "Free queso on my birthday?" but queso isn't stated as a term, nor when the reward is issued. Redeem at the five San Antonio locations.

deals.title: Free queso for joining Torchy's Rewards
deals.details: Join Torchy's Rewards (free; ages 13+; requires first and last name, email, phone, birthdate and ZIP code, plus email verification) to get free queso. Members also get a birthday reward once a year, advertised as free queso. One reward per transaction. Rewards generally expire 14-30 days after issue. Rewards are a single serving unless stated otherwise. You earn 10 points per $1. Alcohol, catering, gift cards, third-party delivery, food-truck orders and special events don't earn points.
deals.notes: The homepage ties the free queso to signing up, while the rewards page ties it to your birthday. Queso size and sign-up expiry aren't given. Your birthdate can't be changed later.

deals.title: Taco Two-Step: 2 tacos + chips/salsa + drink from $9.95
deals.details: Pick two select tacos, served with chips and salsa and a 22 oz fountain drink, starting at $9.95. Dine-in or pickup only (no delivery). Eligible tacos aren't listed. 'Starting at' pricing means the price can go up depending on the tacos you pick and the location.
deals.notes: No end date is listed; it may be a limited-time item for Torchy's 20th birthday (unconfirmed). Offered at Bandera, Lincoln Heights, SA Med Center, Sonterra and The Rim.

deals.title: $1.99 smoothies all day (grand opening)
deals.details: $1.99 smoothies all day on grand-opening day, at this new location only. The owners describe it as available to guests who don't land one of the first 50 spots. Size, eligible flavors and any per-person limit are not stated.
deals.location: 7411 N Loop 1604 E, Suite 107, San Antonio, TX 78154
deals.notes: Only SA Current (citing the owners) reports it; Oct 24 is inferred from "Saturday". Store hours weren't published, and the ceremony starts at 8 AM.

deals.title: Free 24 oz smoothie after first $5+ Tropic Rewards order
deals.details: New Tropic Rewards members get a free smoothie reward after their first purchase of $5 or more made with the account (order ahead online, in the app, or scan the app in-cafe). The reward can take up to 24 hours to appear. It applies to the lowest-priced 24 oz smoothie ordered. Modifications, fresh add-ins, supplements and tax are extra. Limit one per order, one-time use. Not valid with other rewards or third-party services and may not combine with certain offers. Redeem before the expiration date shown in the app. Participating locations, limited time, exclusions apply.
deals.sourceName: Tropical Smoothie Cafe Tropic Rewards (brand page)
deals.notes: Limited time with no end date given; your expiration is set in the app. Separate from the grand-opening promo.

deals.title: Free birthday smoothie (Tropic Rewards)
deals.details: Tropic Rewards members get a reward for a free smoothie on their birthday, and it appears in the app. Hip2Save says it's a 24 oz smoothie. Participating locations.
deals.sourceName: Tropical Smoothie Cafe Tropic Rewards (brand page)
deals.notes: The brand page gives no cup size, redemption window or fine print; the 24 oz size comes from Hip2Save (Feb 2026). Check the expiration shown in the app.

deals.title: Grand opening: first 50 get free smoothies for a year
deals.details: Grand opening of the chain's 10th San Antonio cafe, with the ceremony starting at 8 a.m. The first 50 customers in line get free smoothies for a year. The article does not say how the year of smoothies is redeemed (for example, one per week, or an app or Tropic Rewards sign-up), and it gives no arrival cutoff. This location only.
deals.location: 7411 N Loop 1604 E, Suite 107, San Antonio, TX 78154
deals.notes: Only SA Current reports it, and the date (Sat Oct 24) is inferred from the article. Tropical's own page doesn't mention it. 8 AM is the ceremony start, not a confirmed opening time.

deals.title: Citi Offer: $10 back on $30+ Uber Eats order (use 2x)
deals.details: This is a Citi Merchant Offer. You get a $10 statement credit for each single Uber Eats transaction of $30 or more, limited to 2 redemptions per offer cycle ($20 max). Enroll the offer on the specific Citi card first; Slickdeals and DannyDealGuru list an enroll-by date of 10/24/2026 (today). The enrolled card must be linked to your Uber Eats account and used as the payment method. Valid online only, in the Uber/Uber Eats apps or US website, in USD. Uber Cash and credits applied to the order don't count toward the $30 minimum, so if you stack Amex Uber Cash, the amount charged to the Citi card must still be $30+. Excludes Uber rides, Uber Bikes, Uber Freight, Uber One, gift cards and other non-delivery services. Can't be combined with other offers.
deals.notes: Targeted offer, so check your own Citi account since dates can differ. Public reports say enroll by 10/24 and use by 10/31/2026; no end time or credit posting time is published.

deals.title: Amex Gold: up to $96 back on annual Uber One
deals.details: One-time statement credit of up to $96 when you pay for an annual Uber One membership (about $99/yr) with your Amex Gold Card. You must manually add (enroll in) the offer in Amex Offers, then enroll and pay by 10/30/26. Annual plans only, not monthly ($9.99). Make sure the full fee is charged to the Gold card. Uber One auto-renews, so set a reminder to cancel before next year if you don't want it.
deals.notes: Part of the Amex Gold 60th-anniversary offers, ending 10/30/26. A claim that you must have been a Gold Card Member by 10/16/26 is unverified.

deals.title: $20 Backdoor Chicken to-go on Mondays
deals.details: Mondays only, to-go only, $20. Includes 1 whole rotisserie chicken, 6 tortillas, queso blanco, classic guac, corn pico and 1 bag of blue corn tortilla chips. Order in person at the restaurant's designated spot (window, side door, drive-thru or back door, depending on the location), pay $20 and get the box after a short wait. 'Get it before it's gone' suggests limited quantities.
deals.location: The Rim, 5515 N Loop 1604 W #105, San Antonio, TX 78249
deals.notes: No end date, hours or quantity limit listed, and only "participating" locations take part. Call The Rim to confirm it's available and when on Mondays; it's open 10:30 AM-10 PM daily.

deals.title: Kids eat free Mondays
deals.details: Mondays: a free kids meal with an adult entree purchase (listing says "FREE w/ adult purchase"). The listing gives no age limit, no number of kids per entree and no dine-in rule. Call (210) 451-0563 to confirm before going.
deals.location: 1400 Pantheon Way, San Antonio 78232
deals.notes: Walk-On's San Antonio page lists only happy hour specials, so the deal may have ended; not re-verified since 09/2025. The times shown are store Monday hours, not stated deal hours.

deals.title: $0 delivery fee on Saturdays (Wendy's app)
deals.details: $0 delivery fee all day Saturday on delivery orders placed in the Wendy's app (or Wendys.com) during college football season. Problems with app delivery orders go to DoorDash. Participating U.S. Wendy's in the delivery area.
deals.notes: Saturdays only. Wendy's says 'during college football season'; the 11/21 end date comes from BuyVia and Sporked. Delivery prices may be higher than in the restaurant, and service fees and tips still apply. Delivery orders don't earn Rewards points or qualify for in-app offers.

deals.title: $1 Boo! Book: 5 free Jr. Frosty coupons
deals.details: $1 per book: five free Jr. Frosty coupons plus one coupon for a $1.99 Kids' Meal with purchase. Buy in restaurant, at the drive-thru, at self-order kiosks, or in the Wendy's app or online. Third-party delivery apps are excluded. The Jr. Frosty coupons work only on in-person restaurant orders, not app or mobile orders. No purchase is needed to redeem a Jr. Frosty coupon. Coupons must be used by 12/31/2026, cannot be combined with other offers, and must be shown at checkout. Participating locations, while supplies last; 90 cents of each book goes to the Dave Thomas Foundation for Adoption.
deals.notes: The end date is the last day books are sold; coupons can be redeemed through Dec 31, 2026. Availability depends on each store's supply.

deals.title: $7.99 Dave's Single Combo
deals.details: Dave's Single, small Hot & Crispy Fries and a small soft drink for $7.99, no coupon or offer needed. Available in restaurant, at the drive-thru, in the Wendy's app and on Wendys.com at participating U.S. locations. Limited time; pricing and availability may vary. deals.title: Boorito: $6 entree in costume (Rewards), 3 p.m.-close
deals.details: Chipotle Rewards members only. Wear a costume to a participating U.S. restaurant after 3 p.m. local time on Oct 31 and scan your Rewards card at checkout to get one entree for $6. One per costumed guest. In-restaurant only: not valid on mobile, online, delivery or catering orders, and not valid on kids' meals. Guac (free on veggie entrees), queso, extra meat and other add-ons cost extra. Taxes, tips and sides are not included. Cannot be combined with other offers. Subject to availability, and each restaurant decides whether a costume qualifies. The entree still earns Rewards points.
deals.notes: From Chipotle's PR Newswire release of Oct 20, 2026. Good until closing; closing times vary by restaurant, so no end time is set. The claim is correct.

deals.title: Kids eat free on Halloween w/ adult entree (dine-in)
deals.details: Dine-in only at participating Denny's. One free kids' entree per adult entree purchased, up to two free kids' meals per ticket. No code and no costume needed.
deals.notes: No costume is required, and the deal is Oct 31 only.

deals.title: 31% off online/app orders on Halloween
deals.details: Promo code SPOOKY for 31% off an order on Oct 31, online or in the Jamba app. Per Fabulessly: up to $10 off, excludes catering, combos and packs, not valid in store. The Freebie Guy lists only the catering exclusion.
deals.notes: Not yet on Jamba's site or newsroom, so it may be an app or email offer, or left over from a prior year. Confirm in the Jamba app on Oct 31. The HEB in-store unit may not take online orders.

deals.title: 50 nuggets for $20 (KFC Rewards)
deals.details: Day 13, the finale of "13 Days of Scary Good Deals." 50 KFC Nuggets for $20. KFC Rewards members only, in the KFC app or on kfc.com. One-day offer (Halloween). No promo code; limits apply. Participating KFC restaurants.
deals.notes: Reports that it includes 10 dipping sauces are unverified. Valid hours weren't published.

deals.title: Free kids meal w/ adult entrée on Halloween
deals.details: One free kids meal with the purchase of an adult entrée on Oct 31. Valid for dine-in and for online orders at outback.com (enter code SPOOKYFREE at online checkout).
deals.notes: The 2026 fine print wasn't seen. Last year's terms required a full-price adult entrée, excluded taxes and gratuity, and excluded select TN and MS locations and airports. Participation varies, so confirm with your local store.

deals.title: Free pastry with any beverage (PB Rewards)
deals.details: PB Rewards members get a free pastry with any beverage purchase on Oct 31 only, redeemed through the Paris Baguette app. Separately, new PB Rewards members who sign up in the app get a free pastry with their next purchase (new members only, no end date listed). The brand doesn't say which pastries qualify.
deals.notes: No San Antonio-area Paris Baguette could be verified, so check the cafe locator on their site first. The Halloween menu runs Oct 1 to Nov 1.

deals.title: Hallowing: $1 wings on Halloween
deals.details: $1 wings all day on Sat Oct 31 at all Pluckers locations. Dine-in only. Minimum 10 wings. Flavors can be split only in groups of 10, and normal split-flavor pricing applies. Celery, ranch and blue cheese are regular price. No Pluckers Club points on discounted wings. Costumes encouraged, not required. San Antonio-area stores: Alamo Ranch (11202 Alamo Ranch Pkwy), Brooks (2714 SE Military Dr), North Star (92 NE Loop 410) and Selma (14881 I-35 N).
deals.notes: Advertised as "all day long" with no hours given. Locations list 11 AM to midnight daily, but check holiday hours.

deals.title: BOOGO: free entree w/ entree + drink (Rewards)
deals.details: QDOBA Rewards members only. Buy an entree and a drink and get a second entree free. Valid in store, online or in the app. One per member. Quesadillas reportedly do not count. Gold Status members reportedly get early access on Fri Oct 30. No costume needed. San Antonio has only two QDOBAs, both on military bases and both needing base access: JBSA-Lackland (1385 Reese) and JBSA-Fort Sam Houston (2503 Funston Rd). The nearest off-base QDOBAs are in San Marcos and Kerrville.
deals.notes: This is buy-one-get-one for Rewards members, not a fully free entree. Gold Status members get it a day early. Dates come from one source, and on-base franchise units may not honor it, so call first.

deals.title: 50-cent corn dogs on Halloween
deals.details: Corn dogs for $0.50 on Halloween (Sat Oct 31). EatDrinkDeals says the price is good all day. Participating locations. Sources don't say whether it is app-only or in-store too, whether there is a per-customer limit, or what tax and add-ons cost.
deals.notes: Only Sonic's 2025 announcement confirms this, and no 2026 announcement has been found. Check the Sonic app before Oct 31.

deals.title: Halloween: $1.50 Refreshers & margaritas, $1 pie
deals.details: Reported for Halloween: $1.50 Cabana Refreshers and margaritas, plus a $1 Strawberry Margarita Pie. Margaritas are 21+ with ID. No time window, limits or app requirement were given. Texas Taco Cabana locations, with many in San Antonio; participation may vary.
deals.notes: The only source is an undated image, so the year is unverified. It may be a My TC! app or member offer, and no Taco Cabana page mentions it. Check the app before you go.

deals.title: BOGO 9-pc WhataWings for Rewards members (HalloWings)
deals.details: One day only, Saturday Oct 31, 2026: Whataburger Rewards members get Buy One, Get One 9-piece WhataWings as an exclusive in-app offer. Order through the Whataburger app; you need a Rewards account. Participating locations only.
deals.sourceName: Southern Living via Yahoo (2026-10-21); also The Freebie Guy (2026-10-21)
deals.notes: One day only, Oct 31, for Rewards members. 2026 hours and ordering channels haven't been announced; in 2024 the same promo ran all day through the app.

deals.title: BOGO sandwich on Halloween
deals.details: Buy one sandwich, get one free on Halloween. The source gives no other terms: unknown whether a costume, the app or a code is needed, and limits are unknown. Which Wich promos usually run at participating locations only.
deals.notes: Only one deal site reports it, and costume, size and per-person limits are unknown. Participation isn't verified at the downtown Rivercenter or New Braunfels stores, so call ahead.

deals.title: $0 delivery fee on Chipotle app/web orders $10+
deals.details: $0 delivery fee on Nov 1, 2026 only, during normal operating hours. Order on Chipotle.com or the Chipotle app. Minimum $10, not counting tax and fees. Rewards redemptions can be in the order but don't count toward the $10. Not valid on third-party delivery apps, catering or Burritos by the Box. Delivery menu prices are higher and other service fees still apply (TX is not on the exemption list). Maximum item quantities apply. Participating U.S. locations, within their delivery areas. Chipotle can change or end the offer at any time.
deals.notes: No promo code is listed. This is separate from the $6 Boorito (Oct 31, 3 PM to close, in-restaurant, costume, Rewards members).

deals.title: Free Triple Play combo if World Series has a triple play
deals.details: Only if either team turns a triple play during the 2026 World Series (Oct 23-31). Denny's Rewards members then get a free Triple Play Combo Meal ($9.99 value): a soft drink or coffee, a starter (maple-stuffed donut holes or chips and salsa) and one of eight entrées. Join Denny's Rewards by Nov 1, 11:59 PM PT (1:59 AM Nov 2, San Antonio time). The reward is added to your account automatically on Nov 3. Per Hip2Save, redeem Nov 3 only, dine-in only, one per member, at participating Denny's.
deals.notes: Only happens if a World Series triple play occurs; the last one was in 1920. Sign up by Nov 1; the offer loads Nov 3.

deals.title: Kids eat for 99 cents night (5 PM-close)
deals.details: Kids 10 and under get one 99-cent kids meal per adult entree purchased, from 5 PM to close. You must mention the offer to redeem. Excludes the Safari Sirloin Kids entree. Can't be combined with any other promotion, discount, gift card or offer. Reservations are recommended and walk-ins are welcome. Cha! Cha! is scheduled to appear, but that may change or be canceled.
deals.location: 110 E Crockett St, San Antonio, TX 78205 (River Walk)
deals.notes: Not valid at Disney, Galveston, Las Vegas, franchise or international locations. The brand may change or cancel it. San Antonio closes at 9 PM Mon-Thu, so likely 5-9 PM.

deals.title: 20% off dine-in for vets & first responders
deals.details: 20% off dine-in orders for veterans, active military, police, firefighters, nurses and EMTs. Proof of service required (ID, badge or uniform). Cannot be combined with other coupons. Veteran.com says all locations.
deals.notes: Only one deal site reports it, and no San Antonio-area Kura location could be verified. Check Kura's store locator first.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free Aussie 3-Course Meal (Nov 10-11)
deals.details: Active-duty military and veterans get a free Aussie 3-Course Meal (starter, a select entrée and dessert) when they dine in with military ID on Nov 10 or Nov 11.
deals.notes: Dine-in only, military ID required. The Dinova 2026 Veterans Day guide also lists it for Nov 10-11, but Outback's own Military Mates page doesn't show it yet (it only lists the 10% Heroes Discount).

deals.title: Veterans Day: free entrée from select menu
deals.details: Veterans and active-duty military get one free entrée from a special Veterans Day menu, with proof of service. Dine-in only, participating locations. Limit one per person.
deals.notes: The specific free entree choices aren't confirmed for 2026, nor is a predicted $5 Bounce Back card. Applebee's is franchised, so call your local San Antonio restaurant.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free Pizookie for vets (dine-in)
deals.details: Active-duty and retired military dining in with a valid military ID get a free Chocolate Chunk Pizookie on Nov 11. In 2025, buying a dine-in entrée with military ID also earned a free Appetizer Bounce Back, redeemable on a later visit Nov 12-Dec 31.
deals.location: BJ's San Antonio, San Antonio - The Rim, and Live Oak
deals.notes: These are the 2025 terms repeated in 2026 roundups. BJ's hasn't announced anything for 2026 yet. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Veterans Day: veterans free entree, active duty 20% off
deals.details: Veterans get a free entree. Active-duty military get 20% off all menu items. Alcohol is excluded, and there are no rain checks, gift cards or take-out. Bring one form of military ID: a uniformed or retired ID card, an LES, a veterans organization card or a DD-214. Texas and Colorado locations. The only San Antonio-area location is 8410 TX-151 (near I-410). These are the 2025 terms; 2026 has not been announced.
deals.notes: Terms are from the 2025 release, and a 2026 version may still be coming. The San Antonio location is a franchise that took part in 2025, but its current status couldn't be confirmed, so call first.

deals.title: Veterans Day: 10 free boneless wings & fries
deals.details: Veterans and active-duty service members with a valid military ID get 10 free boneless wings and fries. Dine-in, or walk-in/counter orders at Buffalo Wild Wings GO locations. Not valid online or for delivery, at participating locations. 2026 terms have not been announced.
deals.notes: One source mentions the wings but not the fries, and hours aren't stated. Participation varies by location; check for an official announcement before Nov 11. Not the same as Buffalo Wings & Rings.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free boneless wings & fries (dine-in)
deals.details: Veterans and active-duty military can get free boneless wings and fries when they dine in at participating locations on Nov 11.
deals.notes: Participating locations only; call ahead (for example, the New Braunfels location). The listing's linked source is weak and the brand hasn't confirmed. Proof of service needed.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free entree from limited menu (dine-in)
deals.details: For all veterans and active-duty military, Nov 11 only, dine-in at participating Chili's. Choose one free entree: Chicken Crispers, Chicken Bacon Ranch Quesadillas, Oldtimer Burger with Cheese, or Soup & House Salad. Drinks and tip are not included. No substitutions, and it cannot be combined with other offers. Bring proof of service; the page doesn't say what proof is needed.
deals.notes: The free entree comes from a limited menu, not any meal. Only participating restaurants take part, so call your location first.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free chips & guac/queso/salsa w/ $5+
deals.details: Active-duty US service members and veterans get one free regular chips (classic or Chili Lime) plus guac, Queso Blanco or salsa with a $5+ purchase (excluding the free item, taxes and tips). Show valid proof of military or veteran status at checkout: military ID, VA veteran or health ID, state ID with a Veteran designation, or discharge papers. Only the ID holder can redeem. In-restaurant only at participating US locations, subject to availability. Not valid for catering, mobile, online or delivery orders. Not combinable with other offers. Purchased items earn Rewards points.
deals.notes: Runs during business hours, with no set start or end time. The release dates are inconsistent, so recheck the page after Nov 5.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free meal for veterans (terms TBA)
deals.details: Reported: a complimentary meal for veterans and military members with a valid ID on Veterans Day. Which item is free has not been announced (one roundup says the Sunrise Pancake Special). Blue Star Families also lists a separate 10% military discount when you verify your service in the Cracker Barrel app. Call ahead.
deals.notes: Sources conflict on the terms, and nothing is confirmed for 2026. Check with Cracker Barrel before going.

deals.title: Veterans Day: military offer (free games/dessert, TBA)
deals.details: Per Dinova's 2026 Veterans Day guide: free unlimited game play all day and/or free dessert with an entree purchase, for veterans and active-duty military with valid ID. Dine-in only. San Antonio locations: Rivercenter (849 E Commerce St) and Balcones Heights. Participation and exact terms may vary by location.
deals.notes: Not announced for 2026, and the source wording is vague. An older listing mentioned a free entree up to $20 plus a $10 Power Card. Confirm with the store before going.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free Original Grand Slam
deals.details: Free Original Grand Slam for veterans and active-duty military with a valid military ID or DD-214, at participating locations. In 2025 the offer ran 5 AM-noon. 2026 hours and terms have not been announced.
deals.notes: Not announced for 2026, and hours aren't confirmed. One listing files it under 2025. Participation varies by franchise, so recheck before Nov 11.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free donut for military w/ purchase
deals.details: Free donut for active-duty military and veterans with an in-store purchase (per Blue Star Families 2026). Earlier-year reports: in-store only, one per guest, while supplies last, not valid on mobile or app orders. Participating locations.
deals.notes: Not announced for 2026. Sources conflict on whether a purchase is required, and ID requirements are unclear. Check the Dunkin' app for participating San Antonio stores.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free hot or iced coffee w/ purchase
deals.details: Veterans and active-duty military get a free hot or iced coffee of any size with a purchase, in-store on Nov 11.
deals.notes: Only one source lists this (Dinova); not confirmed by Einstein Bros. In-store only; bring proof of service.

deals.title: Veterans Day: BOGO subs w/ military ID
deals.details: Active-duty military and veterans: buy one sub (any size), get one free. In-store only, valid military ID required. Participating locations.
deals.notes: Not confirmed for 2026. Listings may reuse last year's info, and Firehouse hasn't announced anything yet.

deals.title: Redeem Freddy's Veterans Day combo card by Nov 25
deals.details: Window to redeem the free Combo meal card handed out to veterans and active military on Nov 11. The card has to be picked up in person on Nov 11.
deals.notes: Redemption reminder for the entry above. Freddy's page says cards 'may be redeemed through November 25, 2026' and doesn't say which channels accept them.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free combo meal card
deals.details: Veterans and active-duty military who visit a local Freddy's on Nov 11, 2026 get a free Freddy's Combo meal card. No purchase necessary. The card is handed out only on Nov 11 and can be redeemed through Nov 25, 2026.
deals.notes: You pick up the card Nov 11 only, then redeem it Nov 12-25. Proof of service isn't stated, so bring military ID. Call your San Antonio-area Freddy's to confirm it takes part.

deals.title: Military Appreciation Night: free buffet + drink
deals.details: Wed Nov 11, 4 p.m. to close. A free 'thank you' buffet dinner and drink for anyone who served in the U.S. military: retirees, veterans, active duty, National Guard and Reserves. Dine-in only: no takeout and no rain checks. Family and friends pay regular prices. San Antonio-area restaurants: 5071 NW Loop 410 (78229); 1025 SE Military Rd (78214); 2301 Pat Booker Rd, Universal City; 1042 N IH-35, New Braunfels.
deals.notes: Golden Corral's own 2026 page. It doesn't say what proof of service is needed, so bring ID. Addresses come from Golden Corral's all-locations page.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free entree w/ drink purchase
deals.details: Veterans and active-duty military with proof of service or a military ID get one free item from a select Veterans Day menu with a beverage purchase. Recent listings name 10 wings, a cheeseburger, a buffalo chicken sandwich or a chicken Caesar salad. Dine-in only at participating locations.
deals.notes: Not announced for 2026. Sources differ on the menu choices and the drink condition; one says a free meal plus a non-alcoholic drink. Call your San Antonio location to confirm.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free classic burger (dine-in)
deals.details: Veterans and active-duty military get a free classic burger on Nov 11. Dine-in only.
deals.notes: Only one source lists this (Dinova); Hopdoddy's homepage didn't mention it. Call your nearest San Antonio location before going. Bring proof of service.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free Red, White & Blueberry Pancake Combo
deals.details: Free Red, White & Blue(berry) Pancake Combo for veterans and active-duty service members with a valid military or veteran ID or a DD-214. In prior years the offer ran 7 AM-7 PM, dine-in/in-store only, at participating locations. 2026 hours and terms have not been announced.
deals.notes: Not announced for 2026. The 7 AM-7 PM window comes only from "each year" text and isn't confirmed. Participation varies by franchise, so recheck closer to Nov 11.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free burger, fries & drink
deals.details: Free meal of any burger, fries and a beverage for veterans, active duty, Reserves and National Guard on Nov 11, 2026. Proof of military service required. Military.com says all current and former U.S. military members also get a special-edition Veterans Day decal.
deals.notes: Reported by two 2026 secondary sources, but no In-N-Out release was found. Dine-in vs. drive-thru and hours aren't specified; call ahead since participation can vary.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free kolache & coffee for veterans
deals.details: Free kolache and coffee for veterans and military on Veterans Day (per Blue Star Families). A standing 10% military discount applies year-round with military ID or DD-214. The only San Antonio-area store is 11018 Culebra Rd #106 (franchise, so participation may vary).
deals.notes: Kolache Factory hasn't announced this itself. ID requirement, item limits and hours aren't stated. Call the Culebra Rd store to confirm it takes part.

deals.title: Free doughnut + small coffee for vets (2026 TBA)
deals.details: In prior years: a free doughnut and a small coffee for veterans and active military at participating shops on Veterans Day.
deals.notes: krispykreme.com/promos/veterans-day exists but showed no terms when fetched. Based on the prior-year pattern in a 2025 roundup.

deals.title: Free lunch combo for vets, 11-2 (2026 TBA)
deals.details: In prior years: a free Lunch Combo for veterans and active military from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. on 11/11. Check with your local store.
deals.notes: No 2026 announcement found. Terms come from a 2025 roundup, which itself said to confirm locally.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free burger, fries & 30-min game card
deals.details: Active military and veterans: free double cheeseburger with fries plus a 30-minute game card (Timecard) for free play. Valid military ID required. Dinova says it is valid all day. Participating locations.
deals.location: Main Event San Antonio North and San Antonio West centers
deals.notes: Main Event hasn't announced this. The source may reuse earlier-year text, and another site calls it a prediction. Recheck Main Event's specials page closer to Nov 11.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free entrée from select menu (TBC)
deals.details: Reported: a free entrée from a select menu for service members and veterans with a valid military ID or proof of service. Prior-year listings said dine-in only. Participation and menu may vary by location, so call your San Antonio location ahead.
deals.notes: Not confirmed for 2026; sources describe a yearly practice or date from 2025. Included extras like breadsticks and soup or salad aren't confirmed. Check with your local restaurant.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free sandwich + coffee via Pilot app
deals.details: Veterans and active-duty service members verified through ID.me can claim a free sandwich and a coffee or fountain drink in the Pilot app. Participating Pilot and Flying J locations, Nov 11 only. Set up the Pilot app and ID.me verification ahead of time.
deals.notes: No time window or app sign-up deadline is given, and participating stores aren't listed. Verified service members and families also get 10% off food and drinks in the Pilot app year-round.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free Veteran's Shrimp & Chips
deals.details: Free Shrimp & Chips (six Walt's Shrimp, fries and coleslaw) for veterans, active-duty military and reservists on Nov 11. Dine-in only at participating locations with proof of service; beverage, tax and gratuity not included.
deals.notes: No Red Lobster announcement found. Veteran.com and Military.com list it for Nov 11, 2026, but these sites sometimes reuse prior-year text. Call your San Antonio location ahead.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free Tavern Burger + bottomless fries
deals.details: Free Red's Big Tavern Burger (one beef patty, American cheese, lettuce, tomato, Red's Secret Sauce, brioche bun) with Bottomless Steak Fries. For veterans and active-duty military with a valid military ID or proof of service. No purchase needed. Dine-in only at participating restaurants; not valid for catering, third-party, online, mobile app or to-go orders. No modifications or other burger styles. Can't be combined with other offers, including Red Robin Royalty. Tax and tip not included.
deals.location: San Antonio: The Rim, Northwoods, Alamo Ranch; Selma: The Forum (Agora Pkwy)
deals.notes: One deal site says limit one burger; Red Robin's page states no limit. Hours aren't listed, and participation at each San Antonio-area restaurant is unconfirmed, so call ahead.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free 20-oz smoothie, 12-3 PM
deals.details: Veterans and active-duty military get a free 20-oz smoothie on Nov 11 from noon to 3 p.m., no purchase required, at participating locations.
deals.notes: Listed in 2026 roundups (American Legion Dept. of California, U.S. Veterans Magazine), but no Smoothie King announcement found. Confirm with your local store.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free tall brewed coffee
deals.details: Veterans, active-duty military and military spouses get a free tall hot or iced coffee at participating stores. No size or ingredient upgrades. ID may not be required, but bring it.
deals.notes: No official Starbucks notice for 2026 found. Veteran.com and The Military Wallet list it for Nov 11, 2026 (including spouses), but another deal site still calls it predicted. Mobile-order and drive-thru redemption isn't stated, so plan on in-store.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free meal voucher for vets & military
deals.details: Veterans and active-duty military can pick up a free meal voucher on Veterans Day, to use on a future visit (dine-in or carry-out) for an entrée from a select menu with two sides and a beverage. Proof of service required.
deals.notes: The 11 AM-2 PM pickup window comes from WeSalute's 2026 roundup; Dayton Daily News says to check your local restaurant for the exact window. This year's voucher use-by date hasn't been published.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free taco & drink
deals.details: Veterans and active-duty military get a free taco and drink. In-store only, with military ID or proof of service. Which tacos and drinks qualify, and the hours, are not stated.
deals.notes: Only one deal site reports it, and nothing from Torchy's confirms it. Check Torchy's app or social media before Nov 11.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free lunch from select menu
deals.details: Veterans and active-duty military: free lunch from a select menu on Nov 11 (per a 2026 roundup). In prior years: dine-in, with proof of service.
deals.notes: Only one 2026 roundup lists it; no Twin Peaks announcement found. Lunch hours and terms are unverified, so check with your San Antonio location.

deals.title: Free breakfast combo for veterans and military
deals.details: A free breakfast combo, no purchase required, during breakfast hours on Nov 11 at participating Wendy's. Tell the crew member at the register, or show a military ID or VetRewards card.
deals.notes: Wendy's hasn't announced this itself yet; it comes from 2026 roundups that may reuse 2025 terms. Participating locations only, breakfast hours only, and proof of service may be required.

deals.title: Veterans Day: free appetizer for vets & active duty
deals.details: One free appetizer per person for veterans and active-duty military. Dine-in only, no purchase needed. Valid Wed 11/11/2026 only. Bring a military ID (Hip2Save says a valid military ID is needed). San Antonio locations: The Shops at La Cantera and River Walk.
deals.location: San Antonio: The Shops at La Cantera; River Walk
deals.notes: The page doesn't say which appetizers qualify, the hours, or whether every location takes part. Another source says to bring proof of service (ID).

deals.title: Free groceries (~75 lb) for military & veterans
deals.details: Monthly Military & Veteran Food Distribution. Eligible people get about 75 lbs of groceries at no cost. It is for service members and veterans in need of food assistance. You must register each month at https://soldiersangels.tfaforms.net/20.
deals.location: University Methodist Church, 5185 De Zavala Rd, San Antonio, TX 78249
deals.notes: Need-based food assistance, not a restaurant promotion. It's held on the 3rd Thursday of the month; the page lists dates without a year, so they were matched to 2026.

deals.title: Free Thanksgiving dinner at the Convention Center
deals.details: A free community Thanksgiving meal for anyone who wants one, in its 47th year. The nonprofit is preparing to serve more than 25,000 people with more than 4,000 volunteers. No registration is mentioned for diners.
deals.location: Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center, downtown San Antonio
deals.notes: 2026 hours aren't published. In 2025, doors opened at 9 AM, the feast ended around 3:30 PM, and riders going to the dinner got free VIA rides. None of this is confirmed for 2026.

benefits.title: $10 monthly dining credit
benefits.details: Up to $10 in statement credits each calendar month ($120/yr) when you pay with the Gold Card at Grubhub (including Seamless), Buffalo Wild Wings, Five Guys, The Cheesecake Factory or Wonder. Unused credit does not roll over.
benefits.howToUse: Enroll once at americanexpress.com or in the Amex app (Rewards & Benefits > Benefits > $120 Dining Credit). Then pay directly with the Gold Card at a partner. The charge must post by the last day of the month to count for that month (NextCard). A charge that posts on the 1st counts toward the new month. San Antonio options: Buffalo Wild Wings, Five Guys and The Cheesecake Factory restaurants, or Grubhub delivery (a Grubhub+ membership charge reportedly also triggers it, per InsideFlyer).
benefits.notes: Wonder likely isn't available in San Antonio (it seems to operate only in the Northeast; unverified). Goldbelly and Wine.com no longer count. Credit resets on the 1st, so use it by month end.

benefits.title: $7 monthly Dunkin' credit
benefits.details: Up to $7 in statement credits per month ($84 per calendar year) for eligible purchases with the Gold Card at U.S. Dunkin' locations. The cap is per card account across all cards on it. Separate from the $10 dining credit. Not available on Classic, Traditional or Senior Gold cards.
benefits.howToUse: Enroll in the Benefits section of your americanexpress.com account or by calling the number on the back of the card. Enrollment can take up to 24 hours to take effect. Pay directly with the Gold Card at a Dunkin' store or in the Dunkin' app. Excluded: orders through delivery apps or caterers, Dunkin' locations inside other businesses (e.g., gas stations, pop-ups), gift cards bought online, and Dunkin' products sold at other retailers. Loading the Dunkin' app balance has reportedly triggered the credit, but that comes from Reddit via Doctor of Credit (2024) and is not official. Several charges can add up to the $7.
benefits.notes: Check the Dunkin' app for the nearest San Antonio store. Resets on the 1st of each month.

benefits.title: $10 monthly Uber Cash (rides or Uber Eats)
benefits.details: $10 in Uber Cash each month ($120/yr) for U.S. Uber rides and Uber Eats. Unused balance expires at 11:59 PM Hawaii time on the month's last day (about 4:59 a.m. CDT, 3:59 a.m. CST from Nov 2026, on the 1st in San Antonio) and doesn't roll over. Not for family profiles; one Uber account per card.
benefits.howToUse: Add the Gold Card to your Uber account (not through Apple Pay or PayPal, which are ineligible). At checkout, keep Uber Cash toggled on and select an American Express card as the payment method. Any amount above the Uber Cash balance is charged to that card. Uber Cash is deposited on the 1st. If it hasn't appeared by 5:00 PM HST on the 1st, call the number on the back of the card.
benefits.notes: Gold gets no extra December amount (that is a Platinum perk). Use it by the last day of each month.

benefits.title: $50 semiannual Resy credit
benefits.details: Up to $100 in statement credits per calendar year at more than 10,000 qualifying U.S. Resy restaurants: up to $50 for January-June and up to $50 for July-December. Unused credit does not carry over to the next half-year. The current window ends Dec 31, 2026.
benefits.howToUse: Enroll in Benefits, then pay with the Gold Card at a qualifying U.S. Resy restaurant. Per third-party guides, eligible Resy.com/Resy app purchases and Resy Pay also count. Timing depends on the posting date: a meal on Dec 31 must post on Dec 31 to count for July-December. Otherwise it counts toward Jan-Jun 2027 (NextCard). To find San Antonio restaurants, browse San Antonio on Resy.
benefits.notes: Applies only at restaurants marked eligible on Resy when you pay, and Amex can change that list. Not confirmed which San Antonio restaurants qualify. Use each half's credit by Jun 30 or Dec 31.

benefits.cardName: The Platinum Card from American Express
benefits.title: $100 quarterly Resy dining credit
benefits.details: Up to $100 in statement credits per calendar quarter ($400/yr) at eligible U.S. Resy restaurants with the enrolled Platinum Card. Current quarter ends Dec 31, 2026; unused credit expires at quarter end. No need to book through Resy, and purchases can add up. Gift cards and merchandise don't count.
benefits.howToUse: Enroll once in the Amex app or website (Rewards & Benefits > Benefits). Before you go, check that the San Antonio restaurant's Resy page or app listing shows the 'Qualifies for Resy Credit' indicator under the reservation times. Then pay the bill with the Platinum Card.
benefits.notes: Since Aug 1, 2026 it only works at restaurants marked eligible on Resy when you pay, and Amex can change that list. Not confirmed which San Antonio restaurants qualify.

benefits.cardName: The Platinum Card from American Express
benefits.title: $15 monthly Uber Cash (Uber Eats or rides)
benefits.details: $15 in Uber Cash each month (up to $200/yr with the December bonus) for U.S. Uber rides and Uber Eats. Unused Uber Cash expires at month end. Needs an Amex card as the payment method with Uber Cash turned on; cards added via Apple Pay or PayPal and family profiles don't qualify.
benefits.howToUse: Add the Platinum Card directly as a payment method in the Uber or Uber Eats app; Uber Cash can take up to 48 hours to appear. When you order on Uber Eats, keep Uber Cash on and an Amex card selected. Use it before the last day of each month.
benefits.notes: No longer includes Uber VIP status; since May 7, 2026 it comes with 24/7 Signature Support for Amex in the Uber apps instead. The $15 amount is unchanged.

benefits.cardName: The Platinum Card from American Express
benefits.title: $20 December Uber Cash bonus
benefits.details: An extra $20 in Uber Cash in December, on top of that month's $15 ($35 total in December). Same rules as the monthly Uber Cash: U.S. rides and Uber Eats orders only, an Amex card selected as payment, and it expires at the end of December (2026-12-31).
benefits.howToUse: Same setup as the monthly Uber Cash. Spend the whole $35 by Dec 31.
benefits.notes: Claim confirmed by Uber's Amex page and the Amex card page.

benefits.cardName: The Platinum Card from American Express
benefits.title: $120/yr Uber One membership credit
benefits.details: Up to $120 in statement credits per calendar year on auto-renewing Uber One membership fees (monthly or annual plan) charged to the Platinum Card. Uber One includes $0 delivery fees on eligible Uber Eats orders. This credit is separate from the $200 Uber Cash. Credits can take up to 8 weeks to post. The allowance resets on Jan 1.
benefits.howToUse: Buy or renew an auto-renewing Uber One membership with the Platinum Card. Turn Uber Cash off for the membership payment so the fee goes on the card; otherwise you won't get the full credit.
benefits.notes: Claim confirmed. A monthly plan uses the credit month by month; an annual plan uses it in one charge.

benefits.cardName: The Platinum Card from American Express
benefits.title: $12.95/mo Walmart+ credit (grocery delivery)
benefits.details: Statement credit of up to $12.95 plus tax each month (up to $155/yr) for one auto-renewing monthly Walmart+ membership paid with the Platinum Card. Walmart+ includes grocery delivery from Walmart stores. Annual plans don't qualify.
benefits.howToUse: Pay for a monthly Walmart+ membership with the Platinum Card.
benefits.notes: Grocery delivery, not restaurant meals. Only the monthly Walmart+ plan counts.

benefits.cardName: The Platinum Card from American Express
benefits.title: Global Dining Access by Resy (priority tables)
benefits.details: Reservations held for Global Dining Access members at in-demand Resy restaurants, Priority Notify alerts when a table opens, early access to Resy events, and a VIP diner badge. Access varies by restaurant and tables are not guaranteed.
benefits.howToUse: Add the Platinum Card to your Resy profile (Account > Payment Methods) and book in the Resy app or on resy.com.
benefits.notes: No Global Dining Access restaurants found in San Antonio, so reserved tables may only help when traveling. Priority Notify works at any Resy restaurant.

benefits.title: 5% back on up to $500 top-category spend per cycle
benefits.details: 5% cash back on the first $500 spent in your top eligible category each billing cycle (up to $25 back); 1% after. Restaurants and grocery stores are eligible categories. Resets each billing cycle, which follows your statement date, not the calendar month.
benefits.howToUse: Make the food category your highest-spend category for the cycle. Citi applies the 5% automatically to whichever eligible category is highest.
benefits.notes: Existing cardholders only; applications closed May 28, 2026. Only one source confirms the 5%/$500 structure and the eligible categories couldn't be rechecked. It caps earnings; it isn't a credit.
